	local base = Registry.get(entry.id) or entry
	local any = false
	for order, slot in Attachments.Slots do
		local options = Registry.options(base, slot)
		if #options == 0 then
			continue
		end
		any = true
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Name = slot
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
		row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		row.LayoutOrder = order
		row.Parent = list
		local rowLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		rowLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		rowLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		rowLayout.Parent = row

		local heading = text(row, LABELS, 13, MUTED)
		heading.Text = string.upper(slot)
		heading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
		heading.LayoutOrder = 0

		local buttons = Instance.new("Frame")
		buttons.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		buttons.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0)
		buttons.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		buttons.LayoutOrder = 1
		buttons.Parent = row
		local flow = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
		flow.CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 26)
		flow.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
		flow.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		flow.Parent = buttons

		local current = entry.fitted[slot]
		button(buttons, "None", current == nil, 0, function()
			if onPick then
				onPick(slot, nil)
			end
		end)
		for index, id in options do
			local attachment = Attachments.get(id)
			button(buttons, if attachment then attachment.name else id, current == id, index, function()
				if onPick then
					onPick(slot, id)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	if not any then
		local none = text(list, LABELS, 14, MUTED)
		none.Text = "This weapon takes no attachments."
		none.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	end
end

-- Opens the menu for `entry`, or closes it if it is open.
function AttachmentMenu.toggle(entry: Registry.Entry, pick: Pick)
	if open then
		AttachmentMenu.close()
		return
	end
	onPick = pick
	render(entry)
	if gui then
		gui.Enabled = true
		open = true
	end
end

-- Shows the weapon again after it was rebuilt, if the menu is open.
function AttachmentMenu.refresh(entry: Registry.Entry)
	generation += 1
	if open and shown and shown.id == entry.id then
		render(entry)
	elseif open then
		AttachmentMenu.close()
	end
end

--[[
	Closes the menu unless the weapon comes back first. Fitting an attachment
	rebuilds the weapon, which puts it away and draws it again a moment later;
	the menu should stay open through that.
]]
function AttachmentMenu.closeSoon()
	if not open then
		return
	end
	local waitingFor = generation
	task.delay(0.75, function()
		if generation == waitingFor then
			AttachmentMenu.close()
		end
	end)
end

function AttachmentMenu.isOpen(): boolean
	return open
end

function AttachmentMenu.close()
	open = false
	if gui then
		gui.Enabled = false
	end
end

return AttachmentMenu

--!strict
--[[
	Characters
	The third-person view: makes every character that holds a weapon actually
	hold it, with the trigger hand on the grip, the support hand on the
	handguard, the arms following where the player aims, and the weapon's
	moving parts moving.

	This runs on each client for every character it can see, including the
	local player's own. Nothing is replicated but a little state per player
	(aim pitch, whether they are aiming, and what action they started); each
	client turns that into arm poses locally, by writing joint Transforms after
	the Animator has run.

	In third person the weapon is still welded to the trigger hand, as any
	Roblox Tool is. So the trigger hand is solved to where the weapon should
	be, the weapon follows it, and the support hand is solved onto the weapon.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Framework = script.Parent.Parent

local Animator = require(Framework.Animation.Animator)
local Arms = require(Framework.Animation.Arms)
local Encoded = require(Framework.Animation.Encoded)
local Logger = require(Framework.Core.Logger)
local Registry = require(Framework.Weapons.Registry)

-- A joint the Animator also writes to. We lay our own rotation over
-- whatever animation is playing instead of replacing it.
type Layered = {
	joint: Arms.Joint,
	base: CFrame, -- the Animator's most recent value
	written: CFrame?, -- what we last wrote on top of it
}

type Tracked = {
	player: Player,
	character: Model,
	weapon: Instance,
	entry: Registry.Entry,
	animator: Animator.Animator,
	rig: Arms.Rig?,
	waist: Layered?,
	neck: Layered?,
	joints: { [string]: Arms.Joint },
	hip: CFrame,
	aimed: CFrame,
	pitch: number,
	pitchTarget: number,
	aim: number,
	aiming: boolean,
	driven: boolean,
	hidden: boolean,
}

local WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE = "OrdnanceWeapon"
local EYE_HEIGHT = 1.5 -- studs above the root part, for both rig types
local RIGHT_POLE = Vector3.new(0.55, -1, 0.45)
local LEFT_POLE = Vector3.new(-0.65, -0.8, 0.3)

local log = Logger.scope("Characters")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Characters = {}

local tracked: { [Player]: Tracked } = {}
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local perPlayer: { [Player]: { RBXScriptConnection } } = {}
local localFirstPerson = false

-- Roblox hides the character in first person but not the Tool it holds, so
-- the world weapon is hidden here while the viewmodel stands in for it.
local function setWeaponHidden(entry: Tracked, hidden: boolean)
	if entry.hidden == hidden then
		return
	end
	entry.hidden = hidden
	for _, descendant in entry.weapon:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = if hidden then 1 else 0
		end
	end
end

-- Multiplies `extra` onto a joint the Animator is also driving. If the
-- joint still holds what we wrote, the Animator did not run this frame, and
-- the remembered base is used again so the rotation cannot pile up.
local function layer(slot: Layered, extra: CFrame)
	local current = slot.joint.Transform
	if slot.written == nil or current ~= slot.written then
		slot.base = current
	end
	local value = extra * slot.base
	slot.joint.Transform = value
	slot.written = value
end

local function unlayer(slot: Layered?)
	if slot and slot.written then
		slot.joint.Transform = slot.base
		slot.written = nil
	end
end

local function findLayered(character: Model, partName: string, jointName: string): Layered?
	local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
	local joint = if part then Arms.joint(part, jointName) else nil
	if joint == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return { joint = joint, base = joint.Transform, written = nil }
end

local function release(entry: Tracked)
	unlayer(entry.waist)
	unlayer(entry.neck)
	local rig = entry.rig
	if rig and entry.driven then
		Arms.release(rig.right)
		Arms.release(rig.left)
	end
	for _, joint in entry.joints do
		joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
	end
	entry.driven = false
end

local function untrack(player: Player)
	local entry = tracked[player]
	if entry then
		tracked[player] = nil
		release(entry)
		setWeaponHidden(entry, false)
	end
end

-- The joints holding each weapon part to the handle, by part name.
local function findPartJoints(weapon: Instance): { [string]: Arms.Joint }
	local joints: { [string]: Arms.Joint } = {}
	local handle = weapon:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		or (if weapon:IsA("Model") then weapon.PrimaryPart else nil)
	if handle then
		for _, child in handle:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Motor6D") and child.Part0 == handle then
				joints[child.Name] = child :: any
			end
		end
	end
	return joints
end

local function track(player: Player, character: Model, weapon: Instance)
	local entry = Registry.entryFor(weapon)
	if entry == nil then
		return
	end
	untrack(player)

	local config = entry.config
	local animator = Animator.new(entry)
	animator:setAction("Equip", os.clock(), config.Handling.EquipTime)
	tracked[player] = {
		player = player,
		character = character,
		weapon = weapon,
		entry = entry,
		animator = animator,
		rig = nil,
		waist = nil,
		neck = nil,
		joints = findPartJoints(weapon),
		hip = Encoded.frame(config.ThirdPerson.Offset) or CFrame.new(0.42, -0.74, -0.3),
		aimed = Encoded.frame(config.ThirdPerson.AimOffset) or CFrame.new(0.22, -0.5, -0.42),
		pitch = 0,
		pitchTarget = 0,
		aim = 0,
		aiming = false,
		driven = false,
		hidden = false,
	}
end

local function onChildAdded(player: Player, character: Model, child: Instance)
	if child:GetAttribute(WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE) ~= nil and (child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Model")) then
		track(player, character, child)
	end
end

local function onCharacter(player: Player, character: Model)
	untrack(player)
	local list = perPlayer[player]
	if list == nil then
		return
	end
	-- Index 1 is the CharacterAdded connection; the rest belong to the old character.
	for index = #list, 2, -1 do
		list[index]:Disconnect()
		list[index] = nil
	end
	table.insert(
		list,
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(log:Wrap(function(child)
			onChildAdded(player, character, child)
		end))
	)
	table.insert(
		list,
		character.ChildRemoved:Connect(log:Wrap(function(child)
			local entry = tracked[player]
			if entry and entry.weapon == child then
				untrack(player)
			end
		end))
	)
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
		onChildAdded(player, character, child)
	end
end

local function onPlayer(player: Player)
	perPlayer[player] = {
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(log:Wrap(function(character)
			onCharacter(player, character)
		end)),
	}
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player, player.Character)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	untrack(player)
	local list = perPlayer[player]
	if list then
		for _, connection in list do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		perPlayer[player] = nil
	end
end

local function step(entry: Tracked, now: number, deltaTime: number)
	local character = entry.character
	if character.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if entry.player == localPlayer and localFirstPerson then
		-- The body is invisible; leave it to the Animator.
		if entry.driven then
			release(entry)
		end
		setWeaponHidden(entry, true)
		return
	end
	setWeaponHidden(entry, false)

	local rig = entry.rig
	if rig == nil then
		-- The character may still be assembling; try again next frame.
		rig = Arms.describe(character)
		entry.rig = rig
		if rig == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	local blend = math.min(1, deltaTime * 14)
	entry.pitch += (entry.pitchTarget - entry.pitch) * blend
	entry.aim += ((if entry.aiming then 1 else 0) - entry.aim) * blend

	-- Stance: turn the upper body side-on so the support arm can reach, lean
	-- it with the aim, and keep the head on the target. R15 only; an R6 torso
	-- is one piece and its arms slide to reach instead.
	if rig.rig == "R15" then
		if entry.waist == nil then
			entry.waist = findLayered(character, "UpperTorso", "Waist")
			entry.neck = findLayered(character, "Head", "Neck")
		end
		local settings = entry.entry.config.ThirdPerson
		local turn = math.rad(settings.BodyTurn)
		local lean = entry.pitch * settings.BodyPitch
		if entry.waist then
			layer(entry.waist, CFrame.Angles(lean, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -turn, 0))
		end
		if entry.neck then
			layer(entry.neck, CFrame.Angles(0, turn, 0) * CFrame.Angles(entry.pitch * 0.9 - lean, 0, 0))
		end
	end

	local pose = entry.animator:update(now)
	local attachments = entry.animator.attachments
	local root = rig.root.CFrame
	local eye = root * CFrame.new(0, EYE_HEIGHT, 0) * CFrame.Angles(entry.pitch, 0, 0)
	local eased = entry.aim * entry.aim * (3 - 2 * entry.aim)
	local desired = eye * entry.hip:Lerp(entry.aimed, eased) * pose.weapon

	local rightFrames = Arms.solve(
		rig.right,
		Arms.shoulderOf(rig.right),
		desired * attachments.main,
		root:VectorToWorldSpace(RIGHT_POLE)
	)
	Arms.drive(rig.right, rightFrames)

	-- The weapon rides the trigger hand, so the support hand is solved onto
	-- where the weapon will really be, not where it was asked to be.
	local actual = rightFrames[#rightFrames] * rig.right.grip * attachments.main:Inverse()
	local leftShoulder = Arms.shoulderOf(rig.left)
	local leftGrip =
		Arms.withinReach(rig.left, leftShoulder, actual * pose.left, (actual * attachments.main).Position)
	Arms.drive(rig.left, Arms.solve(rig.left, leftShoulder, leftGrip, root:VectorToWorldSpace(LEFT_POLE)))
	entry.driven = true

	for name, joint in entry.joints do
		local offset = pose.parts[name]
		joint.Transform = if offset
			then joint.C0:Inverse() * Animator.partFrame(joint.C0, offset)
			else CFrame.identity
	end
end

-- Sets where a player is aiming: pitch in radians (up is positive) and
-- whether they are aiming down sights.
function Characters.setPose(player: Player, pitch: number, aiming: boolean)
	local entry = tracked[player]
	if entry then
		entry.pitchTarget = math.clamp(pitch, -1.4, 1.4)
		entry.aiming = aiming
	end
end

-- Starts an action's animation on a player's weapon.
function Characters.setAction(player: Player, action: string, duration: number, empty: boolean?)
	local entry = tracked[player]
	if entry then
		entry.animator:setAction(action, os.clock(), duration, empty)
	end
end

--[[
	Plays a shot on a player's weapon. For other players, `replicated` also
	starts the bolt or pump cycle that follows, which the local player's own
	weapon state does for itself.
]]
function Characters.fire(player: Player, replicated: boolean?)
	local entry = tracked[player]
	if entry == nil then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	entry.animator:fire(now)
	local config = entry.entry.config
	if replicated and config.Fire.Action ~= "SelfLoading" and not config.Realism.ManualCycle then
		entry.animator:setAction("Cycle", now, config.Fire.CycleTime)
	end
end

-- Calls `each` for every character holding a weapon: (player, weapon instance, entry).
function Characters.each(each: (Player, Instance, Registry.Entry) -> ())
	for player, entry in tracked do
		each(player, entry.weapon, entry.entry)
	end
end

-- Whether the local player's own body is hidden for first person.
function Characters.isLocalFirstPerson(): boolean
	return localFirstPerson
end

-- The weapon instance a player is holding, if any.
function Characters.weaponOf(player: Player): Instance?
	local entry = tracked[player]
	return if entry then entry.weapon else nil
end

-- While the local player is in first person their own body is left alone.
function Characters.setLocalFirstPerson(firstPerson: boolean)
	localFirstPerson = firstPerson
end

function Characters.start()
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(log:Wrap(onPlayer)))
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(log:Wrap(onPlayerRemoving)))
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		log:Try(onPlayer, player)
	end
	-- PreSimulation: after the Animator has written this frame's Transforms,
	-- before the joints are evaluated.
	table.insert(
		connections,
		RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			local now = os.clock()
			for player, entry in tracked do
				-- A character that cannot be posed is dropped rather than
				-- reported again every frame.
				if not log:Try(step, entry, now, deltaTime) then
					untrack(player)
				end
			end
		end)
	)
end

function Characters.stop()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	for player in perPlayer do
		onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end
	for player in tracked do
		untrack(player)
	end
end

return Characters

--!strict
--[[
	DebugOverlay
	Shows the framework's recent log messages on screen, for testing on
	devices where the Output window is not to hand. Turn it on with
	Debug.Overlay = true.

	It listens to the Logger, so it shows exactly what the Output window
	would, including uncaught framework errors picked up from LogService.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Logger = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Logger)
local Signal = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Signal)

local MAX_LINES = 10
local LINE_HEIGHT = 16

local COLORS: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	Error = Color3.fromRGB(217, 122, 108),
	Warn = Color3.fromRGB(217, 162, 122),
	Info = Color3.fromRGB(232, 231, 226),
	Debug = Color3.fromRGB(156, 154, 146),
}

local DebugOverlay = {}

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local list: Frame? = nil
local connection: Signal.Connection? = nil
local lines: { TextLabel } = {}

local function add(entry: Logger.Entry)
	local parent = list
	if parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json")
	label.TextSize = 12
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.TextColor3 = COLORS[entry.level] or COLORS.Info
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, LINE_HEIGHT)
	-- First line only: stack traces belong in the Output window.
	label.Text = `{entry.scope}  {string.match(entry.message, "[^\n]*") or ""}`
	label.Parent = parent
	table.insert(lines, label)
	if #lines > MAX_LINES then
		table.remove(lines, 1):Destroy()
	end
end

function DebugOverlay.start()
	if gui then
		return
	end
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if playerGui == nil then
		return
	end

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "OrdnanceDebug"
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.DisplayOrder = 50

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, MAX_LINES * LINE_HEIGHT + 12)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 21)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Parent = screen

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
	padding.Parent = panel

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = panel

	screen.Parent = playerGui
	gui = screen
	list = panel

	for _, entry in Logger.getHistory() do
		add(entry)
	end
	connection = Logger.MessageLogged:Connect(add)
end

function DebugOverlay.stop()
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
	if gui then
		gui:Destroy()
		gui = nil
	end
	list = nil
	table.clear(lines)
end

return DebugOverlay

--!strict
--[[
	Effects
	Everything a shot looks and sounds like: tracers, muzzle flash, impact
	marks, projectile bodies, explosions and sounds.

	All of it is local to this client and lives in one folder in Workspace,
	created on first use and removed by Effects.clear(). Nothing here affects
	gameplay, and none of the parts can be hit by raycasts.
]]

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config.Defaults)
local Hitscan = require(script.Parent.Parent.Ballistics.Hitscan)

type Config = Defaults.Config

type Tracer = {
	part: Part,
	from: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	distance: number,
	travelled: number,
	speed: number,
	length: number,
}

local FOLDER_NAME = "OrdnanceEffects"

local Effects = {}

local folder: Folder? = nil
local tracers: { Tracer } = {}

local function container(): Folder
	if folder == nil or folder.Parent == nil then
		local created = Instance.new("Folder")
		created.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		created.Parent = workspace
		folder = created
	end
	return folder :: Folder
end

local function ghost(part: BasePart)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
end

-- Plays a sound at a point in the world.
function Effects.sound(id: string, position: Vector3, volume: number, pitch: number, rollOffMax: number)
	if id == "" then
		return
	end
	local anchor = Instance.new("Attachment")
	anchor.WorldPosition = position
	anchor.Parent = workspace.Terrain

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = pitch
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = 12
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = rollOffMax
	sound.Parent = anchor
	sound:Play()

	-- Long enough for any reasonable sound; the anchor takes the sound with it.
	Debris:AddItem(anchor, 6)
end

function Effects.muzzleFlash(position: Vector3, config: Config)
	local flash = config.Effects.MuzzleFlash
	if not flash.Enabled then
		return
	end
	local anchor = Instance.new("Attachment")
	anchor.WorldPosition = position
	anchor.Parent = workspace.Terrain

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = flash.Color
	light.Brightness = flash.Brightness
	light.Range = flash.Range
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = anchor

	local spark = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(spark)
	spark.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	spark.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	spark.Color = flash.Color
	spark.Size = Vector3.one * 0.45
	spark.Transparency = 0.25
	spark.Position = position
	spark.Parent = container()

	Debris:AddItem(anchor, flash.Duration)
	Debris:AddItem(spark, flash.Duration)
end

-- Draws a tracer that flies from one point to another.
function Effects.tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, config: Config)
	local settings = config.Effects.Tracer
	if not settings.Enabled then
		return
	end
	local offset = to - from
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance < settings.Length * 0.5 then
		return
	end

	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(part)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = settings.Color
	part.Size = Vector3.new(settings.Width, settings.Width, settings.Length)
	part.Parent = container()

	table.insert(tracers, {
		part = part,
		from = from,
		direction = offset.Unit,
		distance = distance,
		travelled = 0,
		speed = settings.Speed,
		length = settings.Length,
	})
end

-- Leaves a mark where a round landed on the level.
function Effects.impact(result: RaycastResult, config: Config)
	local settings = config.Effects.Impact
	if not settings.Enabled or settings.Lifetime <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if Hitscan.humanoidOf(result.Instance) ~= nil then
		return -- no bullet holes floating where a character used to be
	end

	local mark = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(mark)
	mark.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	mark.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	mark.Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 21)
	mark.Size = Vector3.new(0.03, settings.Size, settings.Size)
	-- A cylinder's axis is X; point it along the surface normal.
	mark.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(result.Position + result.Normal * 0.012, result.Normal)
		* CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	mark.Parent = container()

	local puff = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(puff)
	puff.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	puff.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local surface = result.Instance
	puff.Color = if surface:IsA("BasePart") and not surface:IsA("Terrain")
		then surface.Color
		else Color3.fromRGB(120, 112, 98)
	puff.Transparency = 0.35
	puff.Size = Vector3.one * settings.Size
	puff.Position = result.Position + result.Normal * 0.1
	puff.Parent = container()
	TweenService:Create(puff, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = Vector3.one * settings.Size * 3.5,
		Transparency = 1,
		Position = result.Position + result.Normal * 0.45,
	}):Play()

	Debris:AddItem(puff, 0.25)
	Debris:AddItem(mark, settings.Lifetime)
end

-- The visible body of a physical projectile. The caller moves and destroys it.
function Effects.projectile(config: Config): Part
	local settings = config.Effects.Projectile
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(part)
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	part.Color = settings.Color
	part.Size = Vector3.one * settings.Size

	if settings.Trail then
		local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
		top.Position = Vector3.new(0, settings.Size * 0.4, 0)
		top.Parent = part
		local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment")
		bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -settings.Size * 0.4, 0)
		bottom.Parent = part

		local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
		trail.Attachment0 = top
		trail.Attachment1 = bottom
		trail.Lifetime = 0.35
		trail.MinLength = 0.05
		trail.LightEmission = 0.2
		trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(232, 231, 226))
		trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.55, 1)
		trail.Parent = part
	end

	part.Parent = container()
	return part
end

function Effects.explosion(position: Vector3, config: Config)
	local explosive = config.Ballistics.Explosive
	local sounds = config.Effects.Sounds

	-- Roblox's own explosion effect, with everything that affects gameplay off.
	local visual = Instance.new("Explosion")
	visual.BlastPressure = 0
	visual.BlastRadius = 0
	visual.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
	visual.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCraters
	visual.Position = position
	visual.Parent = container()
	Debris:AddItem(visual, 3)

	local shock = Instance.new("Part")
	ghost(shock)
	shock.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	shock.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	shock.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 140)
	shock.Transparency = 0.35
	shock.Size = Vector3.one
	shock.Position = position
	shock.Parent = container()
	TweenService:Create(shock, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = Vector3.one * explosive.Radius * 1.2,
		Transparency = 1,
	}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(shock, 0.3)

	local anchor = Instance.new("Attachment")
	anchor.WorldPosition = position
	anchor.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110)
	light.Brightness = 8
	light.Range = explosive.Radius * 2.5
	light.Parent = anchor
	TweenService:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { Brightness = 0 }):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(anchor, 0.4)

	Effects.sound(sounds.Explosion, position, 1.4, 1, sounds.RollOffMax * 1.5)
end

-- Moves tracers. Call once per frame.
function Effects.step(deltaTime: number)
	for index = #tracers, 1, -1 do
		local tracer = tracers[index]
		tracer.travelled += tracer.speed * deltaTime
		local head = math.min(tracer.travelled, tracer.distance)
		local tail = math.max(0, tracer.travelled - tracer.length)
		if tail >= tracer.distance then
			tracer.part:Destroy()
			table.remove(tracers, index)
			continue
		end
		local length = math.max(head - tail, 0.05)
		local centre = tracer.from + tracer.direction * ((head + tail) / 2)
		tracer.part.Size = Vector3.new(tracer.part.Size.X, tracer.part.Size.Y, length)
		tracer.part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAlong(centre, tracer.direction)
	end
end

function Effects.clear()
	table.clear(tracers)
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		folder = nil
	end
end

return Effects

--!strict
--[[
	Gadgets
	Flashlights and laser sights, drawn on every client for every weapon that
	has them switched on, the local player's first-person weapon included.

	The server only keeps one attribute per weapon (OrdnanceLight); each
	client turns that into lights and beams. A light is a SpotLight inside
	the attachment's Emitter; a laser is a Beam from the Emitter to whatever
	it points at, with a dot where it lands.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Framework = script.Parent.Parent

local Characters = require(script.Parent.Characters)
local Hitscan = require(Framework.Ballistics.Hitscan)
local Logger = require(Framework.Core.Logger)
local Registry = require(Framework.Weapons.Registry)
local Viewmodel = require(script.Parent.Viewmodel)

type Beam = {
	beam: Beam,
	target: Attachment,
	dot: Part,
	used: boolean,
}

local LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE = "OrdnanceLight"
local STEP = "OrdnanceGadgets"

local log = Logger.scope("Gadgets")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Gadgets = {}

local beams: { [Attachment]: Beam } = {}
local folder: Folder? = nil
local heldInstance: Instance? = nil
local heldEntry: Registry.Entry? = nil

local function container(): Folder
	local existing = folder
	if existing and existing.Parent then
		return existing
	end
	local made = Instance.new("Folder")
	made.Name = "OrdnanceLasers"
	made.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	folder = made
	return made
end

local function emitters(model: Instance): { Attachment }
	local found = {}
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Attachment") and descendant.Name == "Emitter" then
			table.insert(found, descendant)
		end
	end
	return found
end

local function setLights(model: Instance, on: boolean)
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("SpotLight") and descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Emitter" then
			descendant.Enabled = on
		end
	end
end

local function beamFor(emitter: Attachment, laser: any): Beam
	local existing = beams[emitter]
	if existing and existing.beam.Parent then
		return existing
	end
	local target = Instance.new("Attachment")
	target.Name = "OrdnanceLaserEnd"
	target.Parent = workspace.Terrain

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = emitter
	beam.Attachment1 = target
	beam.Width0 = laser.Width
	beam.Width1 = laser.Width
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(laser.Color)
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.LightInfluence = 0
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Segments = 1
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.25)
	beam.Parent = container()

	local dot = Instance.new("Part")
	dot.Name = "OrdnanceLaserDot"
	dot.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	dot.Size = Vector3.one * 0.12
	dot.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	dot.Color = laser.Color
	dot.Anchored = true
	dot.CanCollide = false
	dot.CanQuery = false
	dot.CanTouch = false
	dot.CastShadow = false
	dot.Parent = container()

	local made = { beam = beam, target = target, dot = dot, used = true }
	beams[emitter] = made
	return made
end

local function drawLaser(emitter: Attachment, laser: any, exclude: { Instance })
	local frame = emitter.WorldCFrame
	local reach = frame.LookVector * laser.Range
	local result = Hitscan.raycast(frame.Position, reach, Hitscan.params(exclude))
	local finish = if result then result.Position else frame.Position + reach
	local drawn = beamFor(emitter, laser)
	drawn.used = true
	drawn.target.WorldPosition = finish
	drawn.dot.Position = finish
	drawn.dot.Transparency = if result then 0 else 1
end

local function step()
	for _, drawn in beams do
		drawn.used = false
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local exclude: { Instance } = { container() }
	if camera then
		table.insert(exclude, camera)
	end
	if localPlayer.Character then
		table.insert(exclude, localPlayer.Character)
	end

	-- World weapons, everyone's.
	Characters.each(function(player, weapon, entry)
		local gadgets = entry.gadgets
		if gadgets.light == nil and gadgets.laser == nil then
			return
		end
		local on = weapon:GetAttribute(LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE) == true
		-- The local player's own world weapon is hidden in first person; the
		-- viewmodel's copy shines instead.
		local shown = not (player == localPlayer and Characters.isLocalFirstPerson())
		setLights(weapon, on and shown)
		if on and shown and gadgets.laser then
			local holder = if player.Character then { player.Character :: Instance } else {}
			for _, item in exclude do
				table.insert(holder, item)
			end
			for _, emitter in emitters(weapon) do
				drawLaser(emitter, gadgets.laser, holder)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- The first-person weapon.
	local model = Viewmodel.getModel()
	local entry = heldEntry
	local instance = heldInstance
	if model and entry and instance then
		local gadgets = entry.gadgets
		local on = instance:GetAttribute(LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE) == true
		setLights(model, on)
		if on and gadgets.laser then
			for _, emitter in emitters(model) do
				drawLaser(emitter, gadgets.laser, exclude)
			end
		end
	end

	for emitter, drawn in beams do
		if not drawn.used then
			drawn.beam:Destroy()
			drawn.target:Destroy()
			drawn.dot:Destroy()
			beams[emitter] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- The local player's held weapon, for its first-person light and laser.
function Gadgets.setHeld(instance: Instance?, entry: Registry.Entry?)
	heldInstance = instance
	heldEntry = entry
end

function Gadgets.start()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(STEP, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 3, log:Wrap(step))
end

function Gadgets.stop()
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(STEP)
	end)
	for _, drawn in beams do
		drawn.beam:Destroy()
		drawn.target:Destroy()
		drawn.dot:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(beams)
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		folder = nil
	end
	heldInstance = nil
	heldEntry = nil
end

return Gadgets

local function build()

local function paint(frame: GuiObject, color: Color3, transparency: number, style: { [string]: any })
	local stroke = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if frame.Name == "Ring" then
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		if stroke then
			stroke.Color = color
			stroke.Thickness = style.Thickness
			stroke.Transparency = transparency
		end
		return
	elseif frame.Name == "RingOutline" then
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		if stroke then
			stroke.Color = style.OutlineColor
			stroke.Thickness = style.Thickness + style.OutlineThickness * 2
			stroke.Transparency = if style.Outline then transparency else 1
		end
		return
	end
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = color
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
	if stroke then
		stroke.Color = style.OutlineColor
		stroke.Thickness = style.OutlineThickness
		stroke.Transparency = if style.Outline then transparency else 1
	end
end

-- The crosshair settings in effect: the weapon's, with the player's on top.
local function resolveStyle(config: Config): { [string]: any }
	local from = config.Crosshair
	if from ~= styledFrom or playerCrosshair ~= styledWith then
		styledFrom = from
		styledWith = playerCrosshair
		crosshairStyle = if playerCrosshair then Merge.deep(from :: any, playerCrosshair) else from :: any
	end
	return crosshairStyle
end

local function updateCrosshair(config: Config, spreadDegrees: number, aim: number, sighted: boolean?)
	local style = resolveStyle(config)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	local gap = style.Gap
	if style.Dynamic and camera then
		local halfFov = math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) / 2
		gap += math.tan(math.rad(spreadDegrees)) / math.tan(halfFov) * camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
	end
	gap = math.clamp(gap, 0, 260)

	-- What aiming turns the crosshair into.
	local aimed = style.AimStyle
	if aimed == "Auto" then
		aimed = if sighted then "Hidden" else "Dot"
	end
	local blend = if aimed == "Same" then 0 else math.clamp((aim - 0.15) / 0.6, 0, 1)
	local base = 1 - style.Opacity
	local hipFade = base + (1 - base) * blend -- transparency of the hip crosshair
	local aimedDot = if aimed == "Dot" then base + (1 - base) * (1 - blend) else 1

	local kind = style.Style
	local length = style.Length
	local thickness = style.Thickness
	local color = style.Color

	local lines = kind == "Cross" or kind == "T"
	local half = gap + length / 2
	for index, hair in hairs do
		local shown = lines and not (kind == "T" and index == 1) and hipFade < 0.99
		hair.Visible = shown
		if shown then
			if index <= 2 then
				hair.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(thickness, length)
				hair.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, if index == 1 then -half else half)
			else
				hair.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(length, thickness)
				hair.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(if index == 3 then -half else half, 0)
			end
			paint(hair, color, hipFade, style)
		end
	end

	local showRing = kind == "Circle" and hipFade < 0.99
	ring.Visible = showRing
	ringOutline.Visible = showRing and style.Outline
	if showRing then
		local diameter = math.max(gap * 2, 4)
		ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)
		ringOutline.Size = ring.Size
		paint(ring, color, hipFade, style)
		paint(ringOutline, color, hipFade, style)
	end

	-- The dot: the centre dot at the hip, and the whole crosshair when aimed.
	local hipDot = (style.CenterDot and kind ~= "None") or kind == "Dot"
	local dotTransparency = math.min(if hipDot then hipFade else 1, aimedDot)
	dot.Visible = dotTransparency < 0.99
	if dot.Visible then
		dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(style.DotSize, style.DotSize)
		paint(dot, color, dotTransparency, style)
	end
end

--[[
	Sets the local player's own crosshair settings, laid over the game's for
	every weapon. Pass nil to go back to the game's. Fields are the same as
	the Crosshair section of the config.
]]
function HUD.setPlayerCrosshair(settings: { [string]: any }?)
	playerCrosshair = settings
end

function HUD.show(config: Config)
	if not config.HUD.Enabled then
		HUD.hide()
		return
	end
	if gui == nil or gui.Parent == nil then
		build()
	end
	if gui == nil then
		return
	end
	accent = config.HUD.Accent
	mode.TextColor3 = accent
	progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = accent
	title.Text = string.upper(config.Name)
	crosshairEnabled = config.HUD.Crosshair
	crosshair.Visible = crosshairEnabled
	gui.Enabled = true
end

function HUD.hide()
	if gui then
		gui.Enabled = false
	end
end

-- Refreshes the display. `spreadDegrees` opens the crosshair; `aim` is
-- 0 (hip) to 1 (aimed); `sighted` is true when the player is looking
-- through a sight, which the crosshair makes way for.
function HUD.update(
	state: State.State?,
	config: Config,
	now: number,
	spreadDegrees: number,
	aim: number,
	point: Vector2,
	sighted: boolean?
)
	if gui == nil or not gui.Enabled then
		return
	end
	-- The crosshair and hitmarker sit on the aim point: the cursor when the
	-- mouse is free, the centre of the screen otherwise.
	crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
	marker.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)

	if state == nil then
		magazine.Text = "--"
		reserve.Text = ""
		mode.Text = ""
		status.Text = ""
		progressTrack.Visible = false
	else
		local loaded = State.loaded(state)
		magazine.Text = tostring(loaded)
		magazine.TextColor3 = if loaded == 0 then DANGER else INK
		reserve.Text = if config.Ammo.Infinite or state.reserve == math.huge
			then "/ INF"
			else `/ {state.reserve}`
		mode.Text = string.upper(state.mode)

		local busy = state.action ~= "Idle"
		progressTrack.Visible = busy
		if busy then
			progressFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(State.progress(state, now), 1)
		end

		if state.jammed then
			status.Text = "JAMMED"
			status.TextColor3 = DANGER
		elseif state.action == "Reload" then
			status.Text = "RELOADING"
			status.TextColor3 = MUTED
		elseif state.needsCycle then
			status.Text = "CYCLE"
			status.TextColor3 = accent
		elseif loaded == 0 then
			status.Text = if state.reserve > 0 or config.Ammo.Infinite then "RELOAD" else "NO AMMO"
			status.TextColor3 = DANGER
		else
			status.Text = ""
		end
	end

	if config.HUD.Crosshair then
		updateCrosshair(config, spreadDegrees, aim, sighted)
	end

	if marker.Visible and now >= markerUntil then
		marker.Visible = false
	end
end

-- Flashes the hitmarker. Headshots use the accent colour, kills use red.
function HUD.hitmarker(config: Config, now: number, headshot: boolean, killed: boolean)
	if gui == nil or not config.HUD.Hitmarker then
		return
	end
	local color = if killed then DANGER elseif headshot then accent else INK
	for _, line in markerLines do
		line.BackgroundColor3 = color
	end
	marker.Visible = true
	markerUntil = now + (if killed then 0.3 else 0.12)
end

--[[
	The picture through a scope: a round lens with a reticle, black around
	it. Pass the scope's settings to show it, nil to take it away. It sits
	under the ammo display and the hitmarker.
]]
function HUD.scope(scope: { Reticle: Color3, Overlay: Color3 }?)
	local screen = gui
	if screen == nil then
		return
	end
	if scope == nil then
		if scopeOverlay then
			scopeOverlay.Visible = false
		end
		crosshair.Visible = crosshairEnabled
		return
	end
	local overlay = scopeOverlay
	if overlay == nil or overlay.Parent == nil then
		local made = Instance.new("Frame")
		made.Name = "Scope"
		made.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		made.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		made.ZIndex = 0
		-- The lens: a square as tall as the screen, black outside it.
		local lens = Instance.new("Frame")
		lens.Name = "Lens"
		lens.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		lens.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		lens.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.92)
		lens.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
		aspect.Parent = lens
		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		corner.Parent = lens
		-- A thick stroke round the circle blacks out the corners of the square.
		local rim = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		rim.Name = "Rim"
		rim.Thickness = 400
		rim.Parent = lens
		lens.Parent = made
		for index, name in { "Left", "Right", "Top", "Bottom" } do
			local side = Instance.new("Frame")
			side.Name = name
			side.BorderSizePixel = 0
			side.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(
				if index == 2 then 0 elseif index == 1 then 1 else 0.5,
				if index == 4 then 0 elseif index == 3 then 1 else 0.5
			)
			side.Position = UDim2.fromScale(
				if index == 1 then 0 elseif index == 2 then 1 else 0.5,
				if index == 3 then 0 elseif index == 4 then 1 else 0.5
			)
			side.Size = if index <= 2 then UDim2.fromScale(1, 2) else UDim2.fromScale(2, 1)
			side.Parent = lens
		end
		for _, name in { "Horizontal", "Vertical" } do
			local line = Instance.new("Frame")
			line.Name = name
			line.BorderSizePixel = 0
			line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			line.Size = if name == "Horizontal" then UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2) else UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0)
			line.Parent = lens
		end
		local centre = Instance.new("Frame")
		centre.Name = "Centre"
		centre.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		centre.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		centre.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5)
		centre.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local round = Instance.new("UICorner")
		round.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
		round.Parent = centre
		centre.Parent = lens
		made.Parent = screen
		scopeOverlay = made
		overlay = made
	end
	local lens = (overlay :: Frame):FindFirstChild("Lens") :: Frame;
	(lens:FindFirstChild("Rim") :: UIStroke).Color = scope.Overlay
	for _, name in { "Left", "Right", "Top", "Bottom" } do
		(lens:FindFirstChild(name) :: Frame).BackgroundColor3 = scope.Overlay
	end
	for _, name in { "Horizontal", "Vertical", "Centre" } do
		(lens:FindFirstChild(name) :: Frame).BackgroundColor3 = scope.Reticle
	end
	(overlay :: Frame).Visible = true
	-- The reticle is the crosshair now.
	crosshair.Visible = false
end

--!strict
--[[
	Input
	Binds a weapon's keybinds while it is held.

	Bindings go through ContextActionService, which gives keyboard, mouse,
	gamepad and on-screen touch buttons from one list of key names. Inputs are
	passed on rather than sunk, so the camera's right-mouse drag and other
	game bindings keep working while a weapon is out.
]]

local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

local Logger = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Logger)

export type Handler = (pressed: boolean) -> ()

local PREFIX = "Ordnance"

-- Where each touch button sits inside the mobile button area, and its label.
local TOUCH: { [string]: { position: UDim2, title: string } } = {
	Fire = { position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.32, 0), title = "Fire" },
	Aim = { position = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0.02, 0), title = "Aim" },
	Reload = { position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.55, 0), title = "Reload" },
	FireMode = { position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.18, 0), title = "Mode" },
	Cycle = { position = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, -0.08, 0), title = "Cycle" },
	Light = { position = UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0.55, 0), title = "Light" },
	Attachments = { position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, -0.08, 0), title = "Kit" },
}

local log = Logger.scope("Input")

local Input = {}

local bound: { string } = {}

local function toEnum(name: string): Enum.KeyCode | Enum.UserInputType | nil
	local ok, key = pcall(function()
		return (Enum.KeyCode :: any)[name]
	end)
	if ok and key then
		return key
	end
	local okType, inputType = pcall(function()
		return (Enum.UserInputType :: any)[name]
	end)
	if okType and inputType then
		return inputType
	end
	return nil
end

--[[
	Binds each action in `handlers` to its keys in `keybinds`. Call unbind
	before binding a different weapon.
]]
function Input.bind(
	keybinds: { [string]: { string } },
	touchButtons: boolean,
	handlers: { [string]: Handler }
)
	Input.unbind()
	for action, handler in handlers do
		local names = keybinds[action]
		if names == nil or #names == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local inputs = {}
		for _, name in names do
			local input = toEnum(name)
			if input then
				table.insert(inputs, input)
			end
		end
		if #inputs == 0 then
			continue
		end

		local id = PREFIX .. action
		local wrapped = log:Wrap(handler)
		ContextActionService:BindAction(id, function(_, state: Enum.UserInputState)
			if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				wrapped(true)
			elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.End or state == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
				wrapped(false)
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end, touchButtons, table.unpack(inputs))
		table.insert(bound, id)

		local touch = TOUCH[action]
		if touchButtons and touch then
			ContextActionService:SetTitle(id, touch.title)
			ContextActionService:SetPosition(id, touch.position)
		end
	end
end

function Input.unbind()
	for _, id in bound do
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(id)
	end
	table.clear(bound)
end

-- The first key in a list that is a keyboard or mouse input, for HUD hints.
function Input.label(names: { string }): string
	for _, name in names do
		if string.sub(name, 1, 6) ~= "Button" and string.sub(name, 1, 4) ~= "DPad" then
			if name == "MouseButton1" then
				return "LMB"
			elseif name == "MouseButton2" then
				return "RMB"
			end
			return name
		end
	end
	return names[1] or ""
end

return Input

--!strict
--[[
	Recoil
	Kicks the camera when a shot is fired.

	Each kick has two parts. The recoverable part goes through a spring: the
	camera jumps and settles back by itself. The rest is a permanent climb the
	player has to pull down against. Recoil.Recovery sets the split.

	The camera is turned by a small delta each frame, after the camera scripts
	have run. Roblox's camera carries on from wherever the camera is facing, so
	the deltas add up to the kick without the framework owning the camera.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- selene: allow(unused_variable)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config.Defaults)
local Spring = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Spring)

type RecoilConfig = typeof(Defaults.Recoil)

local STEP_NAME = "OrdnanceRecoil"

local Recoil = {}

-- X is pitch (up), Y is yaw, both in radians.
local spring = Spring.new(Vector2.zero, 22, 0.8)
local lastSpring = Vector2.zero
local pending = Vector2.zero
local climbSpeed = 22
local random = Random.new()
local running = false

local function step(deltaTime: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera == nil then
		return
	end

	local position = spring:Step(deltaTime)
	local delta = position - lastSpring
	lastSpring = position

	if pending.Magnitude > 1e-5 then
		local portion = pending * math.min(1, climbSpeed * deltaTime)
		pending -= portion
		delta += portion
	end

	if delta.Magnitude > 1e-6 then
		camera.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(delta.X, delta.Y, 0)
	end
end

function Recoil.start()
	if running then
		return
	end
	running = true
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(STEP_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, step)
end

function Recoil.stop()
	if not running then
		return
	end
	running = false
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(STEP_NAME)
	spring:Reset(Vector2.zero)
	lastSpring = Vector2.zero
	pending = Vector2.zero
end

-- Applies one shot's worth of recoil. `aim` is 0 (hip) to 1 (aimed).
function Recoil.kick(config: RecoilConfig, aim: number)
	local scale = 1 + (config.AimScale - 1) * math.clamp(aim, 0, 1)
	local pitch = math.rad(config.Vertical) * scale
	local yaw = math.rad(config.Horizontal) * scale * random:NextNumber(-1, 1)
	local kick = Vector2.new(pitch, yaw)

	spring.Speed = config.Speed
	spring.Damping = config.Damping
	climbSpeed = config.Speed

	-- An impulse of v peaks near v / (e * speed) on a well-damped spring, so
	-- scale it to make the peak equal the recoverable part of the kick.
	spring:Impulse(kick * config.Recovery * config.Speed * math.exp(1))
	pending += kick * (1 - config.Recovery)
end

return Recoil

--!strict
--[[
	View
	The local player's camera while a weapon is held: first or third person,
	where the aim point is on screen, and which way the character faces.

	The framework does not own the camera. It nudges a few settings while a
	weapon is out and puts every one of them back when it is put away.

	Aim follows the cursor when the mouse is free (third person without mouse
	lock) and the centre of the screen otherwise, so both the classic Roblox
	"click where you want to shoot" and a shooter-style locked view work
	without configuration.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config.Defaults)

type Config = Defaults.Config

type Saved = {
	cameraMode: Enum.CameraMode,
	minZoom: number,
	cameraOffset: Vector3,
	autoRotate: boolean,
	mouseIcon: boolean,
}

local FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE = 1.1
local THIRD_PERSON_MIN_ZOOM = 6
local TURN_SPEED = 16

local TURNABLE: { [Enum.HumanoidStateType]: boolean } = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = true,
}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local View = {}

local saved: Saved? = nil
local shoulder = Vector3.zero

-- True when the camera is zoomed all the way in.
function View.isFirstPerson(): boolean
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera == nil then
		return false
	end
	return (camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude < FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE
end

-- The point on screen the weapon is aimed through, in viewport pixels.
function View.screenPoint(): Vector2
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local centre = if camera then camera.ViewportSize / 2 else Vector2.zero
	if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
		return centre
	end
	local last = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
	local usingMouse = last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
		or last == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel
		or last == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
	if not usingMouse or not UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
		return centre
	end
	return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
end

-- The world ray through the aim point.
function View.ray(): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera == nil then
		return Vector3.zero, -Vector3.zAxis
	end
	local point = View.screenPoint()
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(point.X, point.Y)
	return ray.Origin, ray.Direction
end

-- Call when a weapon is drawn.
function View.begin(config: Config, humanoid: Humanoid)
	if saved == nil then
		saved = {
			cameraMode = player.CameraMode,
			minZoom = player.CameraMinZoomDistance,
			cameraOffset = humanoid.CameraOffset,
			autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate,
			mouseIcon = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled,
		}
		shoulder = Vector3.zero
	end
	local current = saved :: Saved

	local mode = config.Camera.Mode
	if mode == "FirstPerson" then
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
	elseif mode == "ThirdPerson" then
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = math.max(current.minZoom, THIRD_PERSON_MIN_ZOOM)
	else
		player.CameraMode = current.cameraMode
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = current.minZoom
	end

	-- The built-in crosshair stands in for the cursor.
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = not (config.HUD.Enabled and config.HUD.Crosshair)
end

-- Call when the weapon is put away. Restores everything `begin` changed.
function View.finish(humanoid: Humanoid?)
	local current = saved
	if current == nil then
		return
	end
	saved = nil
	player.CameraMode = current.cameraMode
	player.CameraMinZoomDistance = current.minZoom
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = current.mouseIcon
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.CameraOffset = current.cameraOffset
		humanoid.AutoRotate = current.autoRotate
	end
end

--[[
	Per-frame camera upkeep. `aim` is the unit direction from the character's
	head to what it is aiming at. Returns true while in first person.
]]
function View.update(
	deltaTime: number,
	config: Config,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	root: BasePart,
	aim: Vector3
): boolean
	local current = saved
	local firstPerson = View.isFirstPerson()
	if current == nil then
		return firstPerson
	end

	-- Over-the-shoulder camera in third person, straight through the head in first.
	local target = if firstPerson then Vector3.zero else config.Camera.ShoulderOffset
	shoulder = shoulder:Lerp(target, math.min(1, deltaTime * 10))
	humanoid.CameraOffset = current.cameraOffset + shoulder

	local turn = config.Camera.FaceAim and not firstPerson and TURNABLE[humanoid:GetState()] == true
	if turn then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		local flat = Vector3.new(aim.X, 0, aim.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			local facing = CFrame.lookAlong(root.Position, flat.Unit)
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame:Lerp(facing, 1 - math.exp(-TURN_SPEED * deltaTime))
		end
	else
		humanoid.AutoRotate = current.autoRotate
	end

	return firstPerson
end

return View

--!strict
--[[
	Viewmodel
	The first-person view: a copy of the weapon and of the player's own arms,
	drawn at the camera.

	Nothing here is uploaded or pre-built. The arms are cloned from the
	player's character when a weapon is drawn, so they match its rig (R15 or
	R6), skin and, optionally, its shirt. They are drawn slimmer than the real
	ones (Viewmodel.ArmWidth, Viewmodel.HandScale): a character's arms are
	built to be seen from a distance and fill the screen when held at the
	camera. Every frame the weapon is placed relative to the camera and the
	arms are solved to reach it.

	Only the local player sees this. Everyone else, and the player too in
	third person, sees the character holding the world weapon.

	The viewmodel is local, anchored and cannot be hit by raycasts.
]]

local Arms = require(script.Parent.Parent.Animation.Arms)
local Animator = require(script.Parent.Parent.Animation.Animator)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config.Defaults)
local Encoded = require(script.Parent.Parent.Animation.Encoded)
local Registry = require(script.Parent.Parent.Weapons.Registry)
local Sway = require(script.Parent.Parent.Animation.Sway)
local Visualizer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Visualizer)

type Config = Defaults.Config

type View = {
	entry: Registry.Entry,
	attachments: Animator.Attachments,
	model: Model,
	weaponParts: { BasePart },
	weaponNames: { string },
	weaponRests: { CFrame },
	weaponFrames: { CFrame },
	right: Arms.Arm?,
	left: Arms.Arm?,
	rightParts: { BasePart },
	leftParts: { BasePart },
	hip: CFrame,
	aimed: CFrame,
	handle: CFrame,
}

-- Which way each shoulder lies from its wrist, in camera space. The
-- shoulders are not fixed points: they are placed so the arms always reach.
-- They point down and out more than back, so the arms leave the bottom of the
-- screen instead of passing close to the camera, where they would fill it.
local RIGHT_SHOULDER = Vector3.new(0.42, -0.8, 0.42).Unit
-- The support arm comes in from the left, across under the weapon.
local LEFT_SHOULDER = Vector3.new(-0.62, -0.62, 0.48).Unit
local RIGHT_POLE = Vector3.new(0.75, -0.65, 0.1)
local LEFT_POLE = Vector3.new(-0.75, -0.65, 0.1)
local REACH = 0.93

local Viewmodel = {}

local view: View? = nil
local visible = false
local hidden = false -- behind a scope picture
local sway = Sway.new()
local lastCamera: CFrame? = nil
local swayInput: Sway.Input = { look = Vector2.zero, velocity = Vector3.zero, grounded = true, aim = 0 }

local function ghost(part: BasePart)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Massless = true
end

local function cloneArm(arm: Arms.Arm, scales: { Vector3 }, parent: Instance): { BasePart }
	local clones = {}
	for index, part in arm.parts do
		local clone = part:Clone()
		clone.Size *= scales[index] or Vector3.one
		for _, descendant in clone:GetDescendants() do
			if
				descendant:IsA("JointInstance")
				or descendant:IsA("Constraint")
				or descendant:IsA("BaseScript")
			then
				descendant:Destroy()
			end
		end
		ghost(clone)
		-- Plastic's grain is meant to be seen from a distance; up close it
		-- reads as noise.
		if clone.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic then
			clone.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		end
		clone.Parent = parent
		table.insert(clones, clone)
	end
	return clones
end

local function build(entry: Registry.Entry, attachments: Animator.Attachments, character: Model): View
	local config = entry.config
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "OrdnanceViewmodel"

	-- The weapon: an anchored copy whose parts are placed by hand each frame.
	local weapon = entry.template:Clone()
	local handle = weapon.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local parts, names, rests = {}, {}, {}
	for _, descendant in weapon:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, descendant)
			table.insert(names, descendant.Name)
			table.insert(rests, handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(descendant.CFrame))
		end
	end
	for _, descendant in weapon:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("JointInstance") or descendant:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			descendant:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, part in parts do
		ghost(part)
	end
	weapon.Name = "Weapon"
	weapon.Parent = model

	-- The arms: copies of the character's own.
	local rig = Arms.describe(character)
	local rightParts: { BasePart } = {}
	local leftParts: { BasePart } = {}
	local right: Arms.Arm?, left: Arms.Arm? = nil, nil
	if rig then
		local settings = config.Viewmodel
		local rightScales, leftScales
		right, rightScales = Arms.scaled(rig.right, settings.ArmWidth, settings.HandScale, settings.ArmLength)
		left, leftScales = Arms.scaled(rig.left, settings.ArmWidth, settings.HandScale, settings.ArmLength)
		rightParts = cloneArm(rig.right, rightScales, model)
		leftParts = cloneArm(rig.left, leftScales, model)
		if config.Viewmodel.Sleeves then
			-- Clothing only renders inside a model that has a Humanoid.
			local shirt = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
			if shirt then
				local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
				humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
				humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
				humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
				humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
				humanoid.Parent = model
				shirt:Clone().Parent = model
			end
		end
	end

	local hip = Encoded.frame(config.Viewmodel.Offset) or CFrame.new(0.6, -0.8, -1.2)
	local aimAttachment = attachments.aim
	local aimed = if aimAttachment
		then CFrame.new(0, 0, -config.Viewmodel.AimDistance) * aimAttachment:Inverse()
		else CFrame.new(0, hip.Y * 0.7, hip.Z)

	return {
		entry = entry,
		attachments = attachments,
		model = model,
		weaponParts = parts,
		weaponNames = names,
		weaponRests = rests,
		weaponFrames = table.create(#parts, CFrame.identity),
		right = right,
		left = left,
		rightParts = rightParts,
		leftParts = leftParts,
		hip = hip,
		aimed = aimed,
		handle = CFrame.identity,
	}
end

local function applyVisibility()
	local current = view
	if current == nil then
		return
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	current.model.Parent = if visible and not hidden and camera then camera else nil
end

-- Builds the viewmodel for a weapon the local player has drawn.
function Viewmodel.show(entry: Registry.Entry, attachments: Animator.Attachments, character: Model)
	Viewmodel.hide()
	if not entry.config.Viewmodel.Enabled then
		return
	end
	view = build(entry, attachments, character)
	sway:reset()
	lastCamera = nil
	applyVisibility()
end

function Viewmodel.hide()
	if view then
		view.model:Destroy()
		view = nil
	end
end

-- Shown only while the camera is in first person.
function Viewmodel.setVisible(shown: boolean)
	if visible ~= shown then
		visible = shown
		lastCamera = nil
		applyVisibility()
	end
end

-- Hides the viewmodel while it keeps updating, for a full-screen scope.
function Viewmodel.setHidden(hide: boolean)
	if hidden ~= hide then
		hidden = hide
		applyVisibility()
	end
end

-- The viewmodel's model while it is on screen, for lights and lasers.
function Viewmodel.getModel(): Model?
	local current = view
	return if current and visible and not hidden then current.model else nil
end

function Viewmodel.isVisible(): boolean
	return visible and view ~= nil
end

-- Where the muzzle is on screen, for first-person muzzle flashes and tracers.
function Viewmodel.muzzle(): Vector3?
	local current = view
	if current == nil or not visible then
		return nil
	end
	return (current.handle * current.attachments.barrel).Position
end

function Viewmodel.kick(config: Config, aim: number)
	sway:kick(config, aim)
end

local function solveArm(
	arm: Arms.Arm,
	parts: { BasePart },
	base: CFrame,
	grip: CFrame,
	shoulderDirection: Vector3,
	pole: Vector3
)
	local reach: number
	local wrist: Vector3
	if arm.rig == "R15" then
		reach = (arm.upperLength + arm.lowerLength) * REACH
		wrist = (grip * arm.grip:Inverse()) * arm.handTop
	else
		reach = (arm.grip.Position - arm.pivot).Magnitude
		wrist = grip.Position
	end
	local shoulder = wrist + base:VectorToWorldSpace(shoulderDirection) * reach
	Arms.place(parts, Arms.solve(arm, shoulder, grip, base:VectorToWorldSpace(pole)))
end

--[[
	Places the viewmodel for this frame. Call after the camera has updated.
	`velocity` is the character's world velocity and `aim` is 0 to 1.
]]
function Viewmodel.update(
	deltaTime: number,
	pose: Animator.Pose,
	aim: number,
	velocity: Vector3,
	grounded: boolean
)
	local current = view
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if current == nil or camera == nil or not visible then
		return
	end
	local config = current.entry.config
	local cameraFrame = camera.CFrame

	local previous = lastCamera
	if previous then
		local pitch, yaw = previous:ToObjectSpace(cameraFrame):ToOrientation()
		swayInput.look = Vector2.new(yaw, pitch)
	else
		swayInput.look = Vector2.zero
	end
	lastCamera = cameraFrame
	swayInput.velocity = cameraFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(velocity)
	swayInput.grounded = grounded
	swayInput.aim = aim

	local base = cameraFrame * sway:update(deltaTime, config, swayInput)
	local eased = aim * aim * (3 - 2 * aim)
	local handle = base * current.hip:Lerp(current.aimed, eased) * pose.weapon
	current.handle = handle

	local frames = current.weaponFrames
	for index, rest in current.weaponRests do
		local offset = pose.parts[current.weaponNames[index]]
		frames[index] = handle * (if offset then Animator.partFrame(rest, offset) else rest)
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(current.weaponParts, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)

	local right, left = current.right, current.left
	if right and left then
		solveArm(right, current.rightParts, base, handle * pose.right, RIGHT_SHOULDER, RIGHT_POLE)
		solveArm(left, current.leftParts, base, handle * pose.left, LEFT_SHOULDER, LEFT_POLE)
	end

	-- Debug gizmos, redrawn every frame so they follow the weapon.
	local visualize = config.Debug.Visualize
	if visualize.IK then
		Visualizer.sphere((handle * pose.right).Position, 0.05, Color3.fromRGB(217, 162, 122), 0.04)
		Visualizer.sphere((handle * pose.left).Position, 0.05, Color3.fromRGB(147, 180, 209), 0.04)
	end
	if visualize.Attachments then
		local attachments = current.attachments
		local marks: { CFrame? } = { attachments.barrel, attachments.mag, attachments.side, attachments.aim }
		for index = 1, 4 do
			local mark = marks[index]
			if mark then
				Visualizer.sphere((handle * mark).Position, 0.035, Color3.fromRGB(179, 191, 125), 0.04)
			end
		end
	end
end

return Viewmodel

--[[
	Config
	Resolves the settings every other module reads.

	Precedence, lowest to highest:
		Defaults  <  Preset  <  Ordnance.Config  <  weapon module

	Both the server and each client run this against the same replicated
	modules, so they always agree on the result without sending it.

		Config.load(ordnanceRoot)
		local global = Config.global()
		local glock = Config.weapon("Glock17", require(module))
]]

local Logger = require(script.Parent.Core.Logger)

local Defaults = require(script.Defaults)
local Merge = require(script.Merge)
local Schema = require(script.Schema)

export type Config = Defaults.Config

local log = Logger.scope("Config")

local Config = {}

Config.Defaults = Defaults
Config.Schema = Schema
Config.Merge = Merge

local base: { [string]: any } = Merge.copy(Defaults :: any)
local frozenGlobal: Config = Merge.freeze(Merge.copy(Defaults))
local presetName = ""
local loaded = false

local function report(source: string, problems: { Schema.Problem })
	for _, problem in problems do
		local where = if problem.path == "" then source else `{source}: {problem.path}`
		log:Warn(`{where} {problem.message}`)
	end
end

local function requireTable(module: Instance?, label: string): any
	if module == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		log:Warn(`{label} should be a ModuleScript, found a {module.ClassName}`)
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	if not ok then
		log:Error(`{label} failed to load: {tostring(result)}`)
		return nil
	end
	if type(result) ~= "table" then
		log:Warn(`{label} must return a table, got {typeof(result)}`)
		return nil
	end
	return result
end

-- Reads Ordnance.Config and its preset. Safe to call more than once; later
-- calls reload, which the plugin uses for live previews.
function Config.load(root: Instance)
	local globalInput = requireTable(root:FindFirstChild("Config"), "Ordnance.Config") or {}
	local globalClean, globalProblems = Schema.validate(globalInput, "Global")

	local presetClean: { [string]: any }? = nil
	local presetProblems: { Schema.Problem } = {}
	presetName = if type(globalClean.Preset) == "string" then globalClean.Preset else ""
	if presetName ~= "" then
		local presets = root:FindFirstChild("Presets")
		local module = if presets then presets:FindFirstChild(presetName) else nil
		if module == nil then
			table.insert(
				presetProblems,
				{ path = "", message = "was not found in Ordnance.Presets; using defaults" }
			)
		else
			local presetInput = requireTable(module, `Preset "{presetName}"`)
			if presetInput then
				presetClean, presetProblems = Schema.validate(presetInput, "Preset")
			end
		end
	end

	base = Merge.layers(Defaults :: any, presetClean, globalClean)
	base.Preset = presetName
	frozenGlobal = Merge.freeze(Merge.copy(base)) :: any
	loaded = true

	-- Configure the logger first so the reports below follow the user's settings.
	Logger.configure(base.Debug.Logger)
	report(`Preset "{presetName}"`, presetProblems)
	report("Ordnance.Config", globalProblems)
end

function Config.isLoaded(): boolean
	return loaded
end

-- The resolved global config. Frozen.
function Config.global(): Config
	return frozenGlobal
end

function Config.presetName(): string
	return presetName
end

export type Layer = {
	config: { [string]: any }?, -- laid over the weapon's settings
	tuning: { [string]: number }?, -- multiplied onto its Tuning
}

--[[
	Resolves one weapon's config from its module table. Frozen.
	`layers` are its fitted attachments, applied over the weapon in order.
	Problems in the module are reported unless `quiet` is set (a weapon with
	attachments was already reported when it loaded bare).
]]
function Config.weapon(name: string, definition: any, layers: { Layer }?, quiet: boolean?): Config
	local clean, problems = Schema.validate(definition, "Weapon")
	if not quiet then
		report(`Weapon "{name}"`, problems)
	end

	local resolved = Merge.deep(base, clean)
	for _, layer in layers or {} do
		if layer.config then
			resolved = Merge.deep(resolved, layer.config)
		end
		if layer.tuning then
			for key, value in layer.tuning do
				resolved.Tuning[key] *= value
			end
		end
	end
	if resolved.Name == "" then
		resolved.Name = name
	end

	-- Fold the tuning multipliers into the numbers, so nothing downstream has
	-- to know they exist.
	local tuning = resolved.Tuning
	resolved.Damage.Base *= tuning.Damage
	resolved.Ballistics.Explosive.Damage *= tuning.Damage
	resolved.Recoil.Vertical *= tuning.Recoil
	resolved.Recoil.Horizontal *= tuning.Recoil
	for _, key in { "Hip", "Aim", "Moving", "Airborne", "PerShot", "Max" } do
		resolved.Spread[key] *= tuning.Spread
	end
	resolved.Ammo.ReloadTime *= tuning.ReloadTime
	resolved.Ammo.ReloadEmptyTime *= tuning.ReloadTime
	resolved.Ammo.ShellTime *= tuning.ReloadTime
	resolved.Fire.RPM *= tuning.FireRate
	resolved.Fire.BurstRPM *= tuning.FireRate

	-- A starting mode that is not selectable would strand the player in it.
	if not table.find(resolved.Fire.Modes, resolved.Fire.Mode) then
		local fire = clean.Fire
		if fire and fire.Modes and #fire.Modes > 0 and fire.Mode == nil then
			resolved.Fire.Mode = resolved.Fire.Modes[1]
		else
			table.insert(resolved.Fire.Modes, 1, resolved.Fire.Mode)
		end
	end

	return Merge.freeze(resolved) :: any
end

return Config

--!strict
--[[
	Merge
	Deep-merges config tables.

	  - Maps (string keys) are merged key by key, recursively.
	  - Lists (numeric keys) and every other value replace what was there.
	  - Nothing is mutated; the result shares no tables with its inputs.
]]

local Merge = {}

type Map = { [any]: any }

function Merge.isList(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "table" and #value > 0
end

function Merge.copy<T>(value: T): T
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local result = {}
	for key, inner in value :: any do
		result[key] = Merge.copy(inner)
	end
	return (result :: any) :: T
end

-- Returns a new table: `base` with `override` laid on top.
function Merge.deep(base: Map, override: Map?): Map
	local result = Merge.copy(base)
	if override == nil then
		return result
	end
	for key, value in override do
		local existing = result[key]
		if type(value) == "table" and type(existing) == "table" and #value == 0 and #existing == 0 then
			result[key] = Merge.deep(existing, value)
		else
			result[key] = Merge.copy(value)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Lays any number of layers over `base`, lowest priority first.
function Merge.layers(base: Map, ...: Map?): Map
	local result = Merge.copy(base)
	for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local layer = select(index, ...)
		if layer ~= nil then
			result = Merge.deep(result, layer)
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Merge.freeze<T>(value: T): T
	if type(value) == "table" and not table.isfrozen(value :: any) then
		for _, inner in value :: any do
			Merge.freeze(inner)
		end
		table.freeze(value :: any)
	end
	return value
end

return Merge

--[[
	Logger
	Every message the framework emits goes through here, so it is tagged the
	same way ("[Ordnance:Scope] ...") and can be filtered in the Output window.

		local log = Logger.scope("Ballistics")
		log:Info("registered", count, "weapons")
		log:Error("model has no Handle")          -- behaviour set by ErrorBehavior
		local ok, result = log:Try(riskyFunction, argument)

	Settings (see Config.Debug.Logger):
		Level          "None" | "Error" | "Warn" | "Info" | "Debug"   most verbose level to emit
		ErrorBehavior  "Throw" | "Warn" | "Info" | "Print"            what :Error() does
		Tag            prefix used on every line
		History        entries kept for the in-game overlay
		CaptureLogService  also record uncaught errors that mention the tag
		Traceback      append a stack trace to errors caught by :Try()

	The logger has no dependencies on the rest of the framework, so it is safe
	to require from anywhere, including before the config has been resolved.
]]
