local function stringify(...: any): string
	local count = select("#", ...)
	if count == 1 then
		return tostring((...))
	end
	local parts = table.create(count)
	for index = 1, count do
		parts[index] = tostring((select(index, ...)))
	end
	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

local function record(level: Level, scope: string, message: string)
	local entry: Entry = {
		time = os.clock(),
		level = level,
		scope = scope,
		message = message,
		side = SIDE,
	}
	table.insert(history, entry)
	while #history > settings.History do
		table.remove(history, 1)
	end
	Logger.MessageLogged:Fire(entry)
end

local function prefix(scope: string): string
	return `[{settings.Tag}:{scope}] `
end

local function emit(level: Level, scope: string, message: string)
	if RANK[level] > RANK[settings.Level] then
		return
	end
	record(level, scope, message)

	local line = prefix(scope) .. message
	if level == "Error" then
		local behavior = settings.ErrorBehavior
		if behavior == "Throw" then
			error(line, 0)
		elseif behavior == "Warn" then
			warn(line)
		else
			-- "Info" and "Print" both land in the output as plain text; "Info"
			-- keeps the word so it still stands out when filtering.
			print(if behavior == "Info" then prefix(scope) .. "error: " .. message else line)
		end
	elseif level == "Warn" then
		warn(line)
	elseif level == "Debug" then
		print(prefix(scope) .. "(debug) " .. message)
	else
		print(line)
	end
end

local function newScope(scope: string): Scoped
	local self = {} :: any

	function self.Error(_: Scoped, ...: any)
		emit("Error", scope, stringify(...))
	end

	function self.Warn(_: Scoped, ...: any)
		emit("Warn", scope, stringify(...))
	end

	function self.Info(_: Scoped, ...: any)
		emit("Info", scope, stringify(...))
	end

	function self.Debug(_: Scoped, ...: any)
		-- Cheap early-out: debug calls sit in hot paths.
		if RANK[settings.Level] < 4 then
			return
		end
		emit("Debug", scope, stringify(...))
	end

	-- Unconditional, untracked print with the tag. For one-off banners.
	function self.Print(_: Scoped, ...: any)
		print(prefix(scope) .. stringify(...))
	end

	-- Warns the first time `key` is seen, then stays quiet. For per-frame code.
	function self.WarnOnce(_: Scoped, key: string, ...: any)
		local id = scope .. "\0" .. key
		if warnedOnce[id] then
			return
		end
		warnedOnce[id] = true
		emit("Warn", scope, stringify(...))
	end

	-- pcall that reports failures through the logger instead of losing them.
	function self.Try(_: Scoped, fn: (...any) -> ...any, ...: any): ...any
		local function handler(problem: any): string
			local text = tostring(problem)
			if settings.Traceback then
				text ..= "\n" .. debug.traceback(nil, 2)
			end
			return text
		end
		local results = table.pack(xpcall(fn, handler, ...))
		if not results[1] then
			emit("Error", scope, tostring(results[2]))
			return false
		end
		return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
	end

	-- Returns a function safe to hand to a signal: it never throws.
	function self.Wrap(_: Scoped, fn: (...any) -> ...any): (...any) -> ()
		return function(...: any)
			self:Try(fn, ...)
		end
	end

	return self :: Scoped
end

-- Returns the logger for a named part of the framework. Scopes are cached.
function Logger.scope(scope: string): Scoped
	local existing = scopes[scope]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end
	local created = newScope(scope)
	scopes[scope] = created
	return created
end

local function refreshCapture()
	if captureConnection then
		captureConnection:Disconnect()
		captureConnection = nil
	end
	if not settings.CaptureLogService then
		return
	end
	-- Errors that escaped a pcall inside framework scripts never pass through
	-- emit(), but their text names the script path, which contains the tag.
	captureConnection = LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
		if messageType ~= Enum.MessageType.MessageError then
			return
		end
		if string.find(message, settings.Tag, 1, true) == nil then
			return
		end
		if string.sub(message, 1, #settings.Tag + 2) == `[{settings.Tag}:` then
			return -- one of ours, already recorded
		end
		record("Error", "Uncaught", message)
	end)
end

-- Applies settings. Unknown or mistyped fields are ignored rather than
-- thrown on: the logger must stay usable even with a broken config.
function Logger.configure(overrides: { [string]: any })
	if type(overrides) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if type(overrides.Level) == "string" and RANK[overrides.Level] ~= nil then
		settings.Level = overrides.Level
	end
	local behavior = overrides.ErrorBehavior
	if behavior == "Throw" or behavior == "Warn" or behavior == "Info" or behavior == "Print" then
		settings.ErrorBehavior = behavior
	end
	if type(overrides.Tag) == "string" and overrides.Tag ~= "" then
		settings.Tag = overrides.Tag
	end
	if type(overrides.History) == "number" then
		settings.History = math.clamp(math.floor(overrides.History), 0, 5000)
	end
	if type(overrides.CaptureLogService) == "boolean" then
		settings.CaptureLogService = overrides.CaptureLogService
	end
	if type(overrides.Traceback) == "boolean" then
		settings.Traceback = overrides.Traceback
	end
	refreshCapture()
end

function Logger.getSettings(): Settings
	return table.clone(settings)
end

-- Recorded entries, oldest first. Returns a copy.
function Logger.getHistory(): { Entry }
	return table.clone(history)
end

function Logger.clearHistory()
	table.clear(history)
	table.clear(warnedOnce)
end

-- Stops listening to LogService. Called when the framework is removed.
function Logger.shutdown()
	if captureConnection then
		captureConnection:Disconnect()
		captureConnection = nil
	end
	Logger.MessageLogged:DisconnectAll()
end

refreshCapture()

return Logger

--!strict
--[[
	Net
	The framework's only network surface: two remotes, created by the server
	inside the Ordnance object at runtime, carrying a fixed set of messages.

	Client messages are rate limited per player on the server before any
	handler runs, and every handler is wrapped so a bad message cannot throw.

		Net.on("Shoot", function(player, ...) end)   -- server
		Net.start(frameworkFolder)
		Net.fire("Shoot", ...)                       -- client
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Logger = require(script.Parent.Logger)

local log = Logger.scope("Net")
local IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()

type Message = {
	from: "Client" | "Server",
	reliable: boolean,
	rate: number?, -- client messages: most allowed per second, per player
}

local MESSAGES: { [string]: Message } = {
	-- client -> server
	Shoot = { from = "Client", reliable = true, rate = 60 },
	Action = { from = "Client", reliable = true, rate = 20 },
	Pose = { from = "Client", reliable = false, rate = 20 },
	Attach = { from = "Client", reliable = true, rate = 8 },
	Light = { from = "Client", reliable = true, rate = 8 },
	-- server -> client
	Sync = { from = "Server", reliable = true },
	Hit = { from = "Server", reliable = true },
	Replicate = { from = "Server", reliable = false },
	Explode = { from = "Server", reliable = true },
	Equip = { from = "Server", reliable = true },
	PoseOf = { from = "Server", reliable = false },
	Act = { from = "Server", reliable = true },
}

-- Names travel as small integers. Sorted so both sides derive the same ids.
local NAMES: { string } = {}
for name in MESSAGES do
	table.insert(NAMES, name)
end
table.sort(NAMES)
local IDS: { [string]: number } = {}
for id, name in NAMES do
	IDS[name] = id
end

type Bucket = { tokens: number, time: number }

local Net = {}

local reliable: RemoteEvent? = nil
local unreliable: UnreliableRemoteEvent? = nil
local handlers: { [string]: (...any) -> () } = {}
local buckets: { [Player]: { [number]: Bucket } } = {}
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local folder: Folder? = nil

local function allow(player: Player, id: number, rate: number): boolean
	local perPlayer = buckets[player]
	if perPlayer == nil then
		perPlayer = {}
		buckets[player] = perPlayer
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local bucket = perPlayer[id]
	if bucket == nil then
		bucket = { tokens = rate, time = now }
		perPlayer[id] = bucket
	end
	bucket.tokens = math.min(rate, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.time) * rate)
	bucket.time = now
	if bucket.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= 1
	return true
end

local function dispatchFromClient(player: Player, id: any, ...: any)
	if type(id) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local name = NAMES[id]
	local message = if name then MESSAGES[name] else nil
	if message == nil or message.from ~= "Client" then
		return
	end
	if message.rate and not allow(player, id, message.rate) then
		log:WarnOnce(
			`rate:{player.UserId}:{name}`,
			`{player.Name} is sending "{name}" too fast; extra messages are dropped`
		)
		return
	end
	local handler = handlers[name]
	if handler then
		log:Try(handler, player, ...)
	end
end

local function dispatchFromServer(id: any, ...: any)
	local name = if type(id) == "number" then NAMES[id] else nil
	local handler = if name then handlers[name] else nil
	if handler then
		log:Try(handler, ...)
	end
end

-- Registers the handler for a message. One handler per message.
function Net.on(name: string, handler: (...any) -> ())
	if MESSAGES[name] == nil then
		log:Error(`"{name}" is not a known message`)
		return
	end
	handlers[name] = handler
end

-- Server: creates the remotes under `parent`. Client: waits for them.
function Net.start(parent: Instance): boolean
	if IS_SERVER then
		local created = Instance.new("Folder")
		created.Name = "Remotes"
		local reliableRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		reliableRemote.Name = "Reliable"
		reliableRemote.Parent = created
		local unreliableRemote = Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		unreliableRemote.Name = "Unreliable"
		unreliableRemote.Parent = created
		created.Parent = parent

		folder = created
		reliable = reliableRemote
		unreliable = unreliableRemote
		table.insert(connections, reliableRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(dispatchFromClient))
		table.insert(connections, unreliableRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(dispatchFromClient))
		table.insert(
			connections,
			Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
				buckets[player] = nil
			end)
		)
		return true
	end

	local found = parent:WaitForChild("Remotes", 30)
	if found == nil then
		log:Error("the server never created the remotes; is the server script running?")
		return false
	end
	local reliableRemote = found:WaitForChild("Reliable", 10) :: RemoteEvent?
	local unreliableRemote = found:WaitForChild("Unreliable", 10) :: UnreliableRemoteEvent?
	if reliableRemote == nil or unreliableRemote == nil then
		log:Error("the remotes folder is incomplete")
		return false
	end
	reliable = reliableRemote
	unreliable = unreliableRemote
	table.insert(connections, reliableRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(dispatchFromServer))
	table.insert(connections, unreliableRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(dispatchFromServer))
	return true
end

local function remoteFor(name: string): (any, number?)
	local message = MESSAGES[name]
	if message == nil then
		log:Error(`"{name}" is not a known message`)
		return nil, nil
	end
	return if message.reliable then reliable else unreliable, IDS[name]
end

-- Client -> server.
function Net.fire(name: string, ...: any)
	local remote, id = remoteFor(name)
	if remote then
		remote:FireServer(id, ...)
	end
end

-- Server -> one client.
function Net.fireClient(player: Player, name: string, ...: any)
	local remote, id = remoteFor(name)
	if remote then
		remote:FireClient(player, id, ...)
	end
end

-- Server -> every client.
function Net.fireAll(name: string, ...: any)
	local remote, id = remoteFor(name)
	if remote then
		remote:FireAllClients(id, ...)
	end
end

-- Server -> every client but one. Used to show a shot to everyone except the
-- player who fired it, who already predicted it.
function Net.fireExcept(excluded: Player, name: string, ...: any)
	local remote, id = remoteFor(name)
	if remote == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player ~= excluded then
			remote:FireClient(player, id, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Net.stop()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	table.clear(handlers)
	table.clear(buckets)
	if folder then
		folder:Destroy()
		folder = nil
	end
	reliable = nil
	unreliable = nil
end

return Net

--!strict
--[[
	Signal
	A small, allocation-light event. Handlers run in their own thread, so one
	handler erroring or yielding never blocks the rest or the caller.

		local fired = Signal.new()
		local connection = fired:Connect(function(weaponId) ... end)
		fired:Fire("Glock17")
		connection:Disconnect()
]]

export type Connection = {
	Connected: boolean,
	Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
	Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Once: (self: Signal<T...>, handler: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
	Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
	DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Slot = {
	handler: (...any) -> (),
	connection: Connection,
}

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
	local self = setmetatable({ _slots = {} :: { Slot } }, Signal)
	return (self :: any) :: Signal<T...>
end

function Signal:Connect(handler: (...any) -> ()): Connection
	local slots: { Slot } = self._slots
	local connection = { Connected = true } :: any
	local slot: Slot = { handler = handler, connection = connection }

	function connection.Disconnect(_: Connection)
		if not connection.Connected then
			return
		end
		connection.Connected = false
		local index = table.find(slots, slot)
		if index then
			table.remove(slots, index)
		end
	end

	table.insert(slots, slot)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Once(handler: (...any) -> ()): Connection
	local connection: Connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		handler(...)
	end)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Fire(...: any)
	local slots: { Slot } = self._slots
	if #slots == 0 then
		return
	end
	-- Copy so handlers may connect or disconnect while we iterate.
	for _, slot in table.clone(slots) do
		if slot.connection.Connected then
			task.spawn(slot.handler, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Signal:Wait(): ...any
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	self:Once(function(...)
		task.spawn(thread, ...)
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	local slots: { Slot } = self._slots
	for _, slot in slots do
		slot.connection.Connected = false
	end
	table.clear(slots)
end

return Signal

--!strict
--[[
	Spring
	A damped spring for numbers and vectors. Used for recoil now and for sway
	and procedural animation later.

		local spring = Spring.new(Vector3.zero, 12, 0.7)
		spring.Target = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		spring:Impulse(Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		local value = spring:Step(deltaTime)

	Speed is the natural frequency in radians per second (higher is snappier).
	Damping is the damping ratio: below 1 overshoots, 1 settles without
	overshoot, above 1 is sluggish.
]]

export type Spring<T> = {
	Position: T,
	Velocity: T,
	Target: T,
	Speed: number,
	Damping: number,
	Step: (self: Spring<T>, deltaTime: number) -> T,
	Impulse: (self: Spring<T>, velocity: T) -> (),
	Reset: (self: Spring<T>, position: T) -> (),
}

local MAX_STEP = 1 / 120

local Spring = {}
Spring.__index = Spring

function Spring.new<T>(initial: T, speed: number, damping: number): Spring<T>
	local self = setmetatable({
		Position = initial,
		Velocity = (initial :: any) * 0,
		Target = initial,
		Speed = speed,
		Damping = damping,
	}, Spring)
	return (self :: any) :: Spring<T>
end

function Spring:Step(deltaTime: number): any
	-- Clamp long frames so a hitch cannot make the spring explode.
	local remaining = math.min(deltaTime, 0.1)
	local speed: number = self.Speed
	local damping: number = self.Damping
	while remaining > 1e-6 do
		local step = math.min(remaining, MAX_STEP)
		remaining -= step
		local acceleration = (self.Target - self.Position) * (speed * speed)
			- self.Velocity * (2 * damping * speed)
		self.Velocity += acceleration * step
		self.Position += self.Velocity * step
	end
	return self.Position
end

function Spring:Impulse(velocity: any)
	self.Velocity += velocity
end

function Spring:Reset(position: any)
	self.Position = position
	self.Target = position
	self.Velocity = position * 0
end

return Spring

--!strict
--[[
	Trove
	Collects things that need cleaning up and cleans them all at once.

		local trove = Trove.new()
		trove:Add(part)                       -- Destroy()
		trove:Add(signal:Connect(handler))    -- Disconnect()
		trove:Add(function() ... end)         -- called
		trove:Clean()
]]

export type Trove = {
	Add: <T>(self: Trove, item: T) -> T,
	Clean: (self: Trove) -> (),
}

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove

function Trove.new(): Trove
	return (setmetatable({ _items = {} }, Trove) :: any) :: Trove
end

function Trove:Add(item: any): any
	table.insert(self._items, item)
	return item
end

function Trove:Clean()
	local items: { any } = self._items
	self._items = {}
	-- Last in, first out, like a stack of defers.
	for index = #items, 1, -1 do
		local item = items[index]
		local kind = typeof(item)
		if kind == "function" then
			task.spawn(item)
		elseif kind == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			item:Disconnect()
		elseif kind == "Instance" then
			item:Destroy()
		elseif kind == "thread" then
			pcall(task.cancel, item)
		elseif kind == "table" then
			if type(item.Disconnect) == "function" then
				item:Disconnect()
			elseif type(item.Clean) == "function" then
				item:Clean()
			elseif type(item.Destroy) == "function" then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

return Trove

local damageHandler: DamageHandler? = nil
local simulator: Projectile.Simulator
local heartbeat: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local random = Random.new()

local function serverNow(): number
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

local function isFinite(vector: Vector3): boolean
	return vector.X == vector.X
		and vector.Y == vector.Y
		and vector.Z == vector.Z
		and math.abs(vector.X) < 1e7
		and math.abs(vector.Y) < 1e7
		and math.abs(vector.Z) < 1e7
end

local function sameTeam(a: Player, b: Player): boolean
	return a ~= b and not a.Neutral and not b.Neutral and a.Team ~= nil and a.Team == b.Team
end

-- Applies damage through the game's handler, if any. Returns (dealt, killed).
local function applyDamage(info: Events.DamageInfo, friendlyFire: boolean): (number, boolean)
	local humanoid = info.victim
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Parent == nil then
		return 0, false
	end
	if
		info.attacker
		and info.victimPlayer
		and not friendlyFire
		and sameTeam(info.attacker, info.victimPlayer)
	then
		return 0, false
	end

	if damageHandler then
		local ok, result = pcall(damageHandler, info)
		if not ok then
			log:Error(`the damage handler errored: {tostring(result)}`)
		elseif result == false then
			return 0, false
		elseif type(result) == "number" then
			info.damage = result
		end
	end
	if info.damage <= 0 then
		return 0, false
	end

	local before = humanoid.Health
	humanoid:TakeDamage(info.damage)
	local dealt = before - humanoid.Health
	Events.Damaged:Fire(info)
	local killed = before > 0 and humanoid.Health <= 0
	if killed then
		Events.Killed:Fire(info)
	end
	return dealt, killed
end

local function tallyHit(
	tallies: { [Humanoid]: Tally },
	config: Config.Config,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	player: Player?,
	part: string,
	distance: number,
	position: Vector3,
	scale: number
)
	local damage, group = Damage.bullet(config, part, distance)
	damage *= scale
	local tally = tallies[humanoid]
	if tally == nil then
		tallies[humanoid] = {
			humanoid = humanoid,
			player = player,
			damage = damage,
			part = part,
			group = group,
			distance = distance,
			position = position,
		}
		return
	end
	tally.damage += damage
	-- Report the most valuable part a shotgun blast touched.
	if group == "Head" or (group == "Torso" and tally.group == "Limb") then
		tally.part = part
		tally.group = group
		tally.position = position
	end
end

local function settle(player: Player, entry: Entry, tallies: { [Humanoid]: Tally }, explosive: boolean)
	for _, tally in tallies do
		local info: Events.DamageInfo = {
			attacker = player,
			victim = tally.humanoid,
			victimPlayer = tally.player,
			weapon = entry.id,
			damage = tally.damage,
			part = tally.part,
			group = tally.group,
			distance = tally.distance,
			position = tally.position,
			explosive = explosive,
		}
		local dealt, killed = applyDamage(info, entry.config.Damage.FriendlyFire)
		if dealt > 0 and player.Parent ~= nil then
			Net.fireClient(player, "Hit", tally.position, tally.group, dealt, killed)
		end
	end
end

local function resolveHitscan(
	entry: Entry,
	character: Model,
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	rewindTo: number,
	tallies: { [Humanoid]: Tally }
)
	local config = entry.config
	local security = Config.global().Security
	local penetration = config.Ballistics.Penetration

	local exclude: { Instance } = if security.LagCompensation then LagCompensation.characters() else {}
	table.insert(exclude, character)
	local trace =
		Hitscan.trace(origin, direction, config.Ballistics.Range, Hitscan.params(exclude), penetration)

	if security.LagCompensation then
		local hit = LagCompensation.raycast(origin, direction, trace.distance, rewindTo, character)
		if hit then
			local scale = Hitscan.penetrationScale(trace, hit.distance, penetration)
			tallyHit(tallies, config, hit.humanoid, hit.player, hit.part, hit.distance, hit.position, scale)
			return
		end
	end

	-- NPCs (and players, when lag compensation is off) are hit by the level trace.
	local final = trace.final
	if final then
		local humanoid, model = Hitscan.humanoidOf(final.Instance)
		if humanoid and model then
			local scale = Hitscan.penetrationScale(trace, trace.distance, penetration)
			local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			tallyHit(
				tallies,
				config,
				humanoid,
				victim,
				final.Instance.Name,
				trace.distance,
				trace.position,
				scale
			)
		end
	end
end

-- True if something solid that is not a character stands between two points.
local function isBlocked(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, exclude: { Instance }): boolean
	local params = Hitscan.params(exclude)
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local result = Hitscan.raycast(from, to - from, params)
		if result == nil then
			return false
		end
		local _, model = Hitscan.humanoidOf(result.Instance)
		if model == nil then
			return true
		end
		params:AddToFilter(model)
	end
	return false
end

local function explode(data: ProjectileData, position: Vector3, key: string)
	local entry = data.entry
	local config = entry.config
	local explosive = config.Ballistics.Explosive
	local seen: { [Humanoid]: boolean } = {}

	for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, explosive.Radius) do
		local humanoid, model = Hitscan.humanoidOf(part)
		if humanoid == nil or model == nil or seen[humanoid] then
			continue
		end
		seen[humanoid] = true

		local root = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local centre = if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then root.Position else part.Position
		local distance = (centre - position).Magnitude
		local scale = Damage.blast(config, distance)
		if scale <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		if explosive.RequireLineOfSight and isBlocked(position, centre, { model }) then
			continue
		end

		local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if victim == data.player then
			scale *= explosive.SelfDamageScale
		end
		local info: Events.DamageInfo = {
			attacker = data.player,
			victim = humanoid,
			victimPlayer = victim,
			weapon = entry.id,
			damage = explosive.Damage * scale,
			part = if root then root.Name else part.Name,
			group = "Torso",
			distance = distance,
			position = centre,
			explosive = true,
		}
		-- Your own grenade always hurts you; team rules apply to everyone else.
		local dealt, killed = applyDamage(info, config.Damage.FriendlyFire or victim == data.player)
		if dealt > 0 and data.player.Parent ~= nil and victim ~= data.player then
			Net.fireClient(data.player, "Hit", centre, "Torso", dealt, killed)
		end
	end

	Net.fireAll("Explode", position, entry.id, key)
	Events.Exploded:Fire(position, entry.id)
end

local function onProjectileEvent(
	projectile: Projectile.Projectile,
	event: Projectile.Event,
	result: RaycastResult?
)
	local data = projectile.data :: ProjectileData
	if event == "Detonate" then
		explode(data, projectile.position, projectile.key)
	elseif event == "Impact" and result then
		local humanoid, model = Hitscan.humanoidOf(result.Instance)
		if humanoid and model then
			local tallies: { [Humanoid]: Tally } = {}
			local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			tallyHit(
				tallies,
				data.entry.config,
				humanoid,
				victim,
				result.Instance.Name,
				projectile.travelled,
				result.Position,
				1
			)
			settle(data.player, data.entry, tallies, false)
		end
	end
end

local function projectileRaycast(
	projectile: Projectile.Projectile,
	origin: Vector3,
	displacement: Vector3
): RaycastResult?
	return Hitscan.raycast(origin, displacement, (projectile.data :: ProjectileData).params)
end

local function reject(session: Session, id: string, reason: string)
	log:Debug(`rejected a shot from {session.player.Name} with "{id}": {reason}`)
	Sessions.sync(session, id)
end

-- Handles the "Shoot" message.
function Combat.onShoot(
	player: Player,
	weaponId: any,
	shotId: any,
	clientTime: any,
	origin: any,
	aim: any,
	spreadAngle: any
)
	if
		type(weaponId) ~= "string"
		or type(shotId) ~= "number"
		or type(clientTime) ~= "number"
		or type(spreadAngle) ~= "number"
		or typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3"
		or typeof(aim) ~= "Vector3"
	then
		return
	end
	if shotId ~= shotId or shotId % 1 ~= 0 or clientTime ~= clientTime or spreadAngle ~= spreadAngle then
		return
	end
	if not isFinite(origin) or not isFinite(aim) or math.abs(aim.Magnitude - 1) > 0.01 then
		return
	end

	local session = Sessions.get(player)
	local entry = if session then Sessions.entryOf(session, weaponId) else nil
	if session == nil or entry == nil then
		return
	end
	if session.equipped ~= weaponId then
		return reject(session, weaponId, "not equipped")
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if character == nil or humanoid == nil or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if shotId <= session.lastShotId or shotId > session.lastShotId + MAX_SHOT_ID_JUMP then
		return
	end

	local config = entry.config
	local security = Config.global().Security
	local now = serverNow()
	local state = Sessions.state(session, entry)

	State.advance(state, config, now, security.ReloadTolerance)
	local canFire, reason = State.canFire(state, config, now, true)
	if not canFire then
		return reject(session, weaponId, reason or "cannot fire")
	end

	-- Cadence: an allowance that refills at the weapon's rate of fire. It
	-- absorbs network jitter without letting a client fire faster on average.
	local rpm = math.max(config.Fire.RPM, config.Fire.BurstRPM)
	local clock = os.clock()
	session.fireTokens = math.min(
		FIRE_BURST_ALLOWANCE,
		session.fireTokens + (clock - session.fireTime) * rpm / 60 * security.FireRateTolerance
	)
	session.fireTime = clock
	if session.fireTokens < 1 then
		return reject(session, weaponId, "firing too fast")
	end

	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character.PrimaryPart
	if head == nil or not head:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if (origin - head.Position).Magnitude > security.MaxOriginError then
		return reject(session, weaponId, "origin too far from the character")
	end
	if security.ValidateLineOfSight then
		local exclude = LagCompensation.characters()
		table.insert(exclude, character)
		if isBlocked(head.Position, origin, exclude) then
			return reject(session, weaponId, "origin behind cover")
		end
	end

	-- Accepted.
	session.fireTokens -= 1
	session.lastShotId = shotId
	State.fire(state, config, now)

	local malfunctions = config.Realism.Malfunctions
	if malfunctions.Enabled and random:NextNumber() < malfunctions.Chance then
		state.jammed = true
		Sessions.sync(session, weaponId)
	end

	local low, high = Spread.bounds(config)
	local angle = math.clamp(spreadAngle, low, high)
	local pellets = Spread.pellets(config, aim, angle, session.seed, shotId)

	if config.Ballistics.Type == "Projectile" then
		local headStart = math.min(player:GetNetworkPing() / 2, 0.2)
		for index, direction in pellets do
			local data: ProjectileData = {
				player = player,
				entry = entry,
				params = Hitscan.params({ character }),
			}
			simulator:launch({
				key = `{player.UserId}:{shotId}:{index}`,
				origin = origin,
				velocity = Projectile.velocity(config.Ballistics, direction),
				ballistics = config.Ballistics,
				data = data,
				headStart = headStart,
			})
		end
	else
		-- The shooter saw everyone else roughly half a round trip plus the
		-- interpolation delay in the past.
		local shotTime = math.min(clientTime, now)
		local rewindTo = math.max(
			now - security.MaxRewind,
			shotTime - player:GetNetworkPing() / 2 - security.InterpolationDelay
		)

		local tallies: { [Humanoid]: Tally } = {}
		for _, direction in pellets do
			resolveHitscan(entry, character, origin, direction, rewindTo, tallies)
		end

		if Config.global().Debug.Visualize.Hitboxes then
			local lifetime = Config.global().Debug.Visualize.Lifetime
			for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if other ~= player then
					for _, box in LagCompensation.boxes(other, rewindTo) do
						Visualizer.box(box.cframe, box.size, Color3.fromRGB(217, 162, 122), lifetime)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		settle(player, entry, tallies, false)
	end

	Net.fireExcept(player, "Replicate", player.UserId, weaponId, origin, aim, angle, session.seed, shotId)
	Events.Fired:Fire(player, weaponId, origin, aim)
end

-- Handles the "Action" message: Reload, Cycle and Mode.
function Combat.onAction(player: Player, weaponId: any, kind: any)
	if type(weaponId) ~= "string" or type(kind) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local session = Sessions.get(player)
	local entry = if session then Sessions.entryOf(session, weaponId) else nil
	if session == nil or entry == nil or session.equipped ~= weaponId then
		return
	end

	local config = entry.config
	local now = serverNow()
	local state = Sessions.state(session, entry)
	State.advance(state, config, now, Config.global().Security.ReloadTolerance)

	local ok = false
	local empty = false
	if kind == "Reload" then
		empty = not State.hasRound(state, config)
		ok = State.startReload(state, config, now)
		if ok then
			Events.Reloaded:Fire(player, weaponId)
		end
	elseif kind == "Cycle" then
		ok = State.cycle(state, config, now)
	elseif kind == "Mode" then
		ok = State.nextMode(state, config)
	end

	if not ok then
		-- The client predicted something the server did not allow; put it right.
		Sessions.sync(session, weaponId)
	elseif kind ~= "Mode" then
		-- Everyone else plays the same animation on this player's weapon.
		local duration = state.actionEnd - state.actionStart
		Net.fireExcept(player, "Act", player.UserId, weaponId, state.action, duration, empty)
	end
end

-- Handles the "Pose" message: where a player is aiming, relayed to everyone
-- else so their copy of the character points its weapon the same way.
function Combat.onPose(player: Player, pitch: any, aiming: any)
	if type(pitch) ~= "number" or pitch ~= pitch or type(aiming) ~= "boolean" then
		return
	end
	local session = Sessions.get(player)
	if session == nil or session.equipped == nil then
		return
	end
	Net.fireExcept(player, "PoseOf", player.UserId, math.clamp(pitch, -1.5, 1.5), aiming)
end

-- Sets a function that sees every hit before damage is applied. Return a
-- number to change the damage, false to cancel it, nothing to leave it alone.
function Combat.setDamageHandler(handler: DamageHandler?)
	damageHandler = handler
end

-- Handles the "Attach" message: a player changing an attachment from the menu.
function Combat.onAttach(player: Player, weaponId: any, slot: any, attachmentId: any)
	if type(weaponId) ~= "string" or type(slot) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if attachmentId ~= nil and type(attachmentId) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local session = Sessions.get(player)
	local entry = if session then Sessions.entryOf(session, weaponId) else nil
	if session == nil or entry == nil or session.equipped ~= weaponId then
		return
	end
	if not entry.config.Attachments.Menu then
		return -- the game hands out attachments itself
	end
	Sessions.setAttachment(player, weaponId, slot, attachmentId)
end

-- Handles the "Light" message: the light key.
function Combat.onLight(player: Player)
	Sessions.toggleLight(player)
end

function Combat.start()
	simulator = Projectile.newSimulator(projectileRaycast, function(projectile, event, result)
		log:Try(onProjectileEvent, projectile, event, result)
	end)
	heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		simulator:step(deltaTime)
	end)
	Net.on("Shoot", Combat.onShoot)
	Net.on("Action", Combat.onAction)
	Net.on("Pose", Combat.onPose)
	Net.on("Attach", Combat.onAttach)
	Net.on("Light", Combat.onLight)
end

function Combat.stop()
	if heartbeat then
		heartbeat:Disconnect()
		heartbeat = nil
	end
	if simulator then
		simulator:clear()
	end
	damageHandler = nil
end

return Combat

--!strict
--[[
	LagCompensation
	Remembers where every player's body parts were for the last second, so a
	shot can be tested against the world the shooter actually saw.

	Player characters are never raycast against directly. The server casts
	against the level, then tests the shot against boxes placed where each
	character's parts were at the shot's (rewound) time.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type Hit = {
	character: Model,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	player: Player,
	part: string,
	distance: number,
	position: Vector3,
}

type Frame = {
	time: number,
	parts: { [string]: CFrame },
}

type Track = {
	player: Player,
	character: Model,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	frames: { Frame },
	sizes: { [string]: Vector3 },
}

local HISTORY = 1 -- seconds kept
local BROAD_RADIUS = 9 -- studs around the root that could contain a limb

local LagCompensation = {}

local tracks: { [Player]: Track } = {}
local connection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local interval = 1 / 30
local accumulated = 0

local function record(now: number)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if character == nil or humanoid == nil or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			tracks[player] = nil
			continue
		end

		local track = tracks[player]
		if track == nil or track.character ~= character then
			track = { player = player, character = character, humanoid = humanoid, frames = {}, sizes = {} }
			tracks[player] = track
		end

		local parts: { [string]: CFrame } = {}
		for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts[child.Name] = child.CFrame
				track.sizes[child.Name] = child.Size
			end
		end

		local frames = track.frames
		table.insert(frames, { time = now, parts = parts })
		while #frames > 2 and frames[1].time < now - HISTORY do
			table.remove(frames, 1)
		end
	end

	for player in tracks do
		if player.Parent == nil then
			tracks[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- The two frames around `time` and how far between them it falls.
local function bracket(frames: { Frame }, time: number): (Frame, Frame, number)
	local last = frames[#frames]
	if time >= last.time then
		return last, last, 0
	end
	for index = #frames - 1, 1, -1 do
		local earlier = frames[index]
		if earlier.time <= time then
			local later = frames[index + 1]
			local span = later.time - earlier.time
			return earlier, later, if span > 0 then (time - earlier.time) / span else 0
		end
	end
	return frames[1], frames[1], 0
end

-- Distance along the ray to an oriented box, or nil if it misses.
local function rayBox(
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	frame: CFrame,
	size: Vector3,
	limit: number
): number?
	local o = frame:PointToObjectSpace(origin)
	local d = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
	local half = size / 2
	local near, far = 0, limit

	local function slab(position: number, slope: number, extent: number): boolean
		if math.abs(slope) < 1e-8 then
			return position >= -extent and position <= extent
		end
		local a = (-extent - position) / slope
		local b = (extent - position) / slope
		if a > b then
			a, b = b, a
		end
		near = math.max(near, a)
		far = math.min(far, b)
		return near <= far
	end

	if slab(o.X, d.X, half.X) and slab(o.Y, d.Y, half.Y) and slab(o.Z, d.Z, half.Z) then
		return near
	end
	return nil
end

function LagCompensation.start(snapshotRate: number)
	LagCompensation.stop()
	interval = 1 / snapshotRate
	accumulated = 0
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		accumulated += deltaTime
		if accumulated >= interval then
			accumulated %= interval
			record(workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		end
	end)
end

function LagCompensation.stop()
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		connection = nil
	end
	table.clear(tracks)
end

-- Every tracked character, for raycast exclude lists.
function LagCompensation.characters(): { Instance }
	local list: { Instance } = {}
	for _, track in tracks do
		table.insert(list, track.character)
	end
	return list
end

--[[
	Tests a ray against every tracked character as they were at `time`
	(server time). `direction` must be a unit vector. Returns the closest hit
	within `limit` studs, ignoring `exclude` (the shooter).
]]
function LagCompensation.raycast(
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	limit: number,
	time: number,
	exclude: Model?
): Hit?
	local best: Hit? = nil
	local bestDistance = limit

	for _, track in tracks do
		if track.character == exclude or track.humanoid.Health <= 0 or #track.frames == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local earlier, later, alpha = bracket(track.frames, time)

		-- Broad phase: skip characters whose root is nowhere near the ray.
		local rootFrame = earlier.parts.HumanoidRootPart
		if rootFrame then
			local toRoot = rootFrame.Position - origin
			local along = toRoot:Dot(direction)
			if along < -BROAD_RADIUS or along > bestDistance + BROAD_RADIUS then
				continue
			end
			local offset = toRoot - direction * along
			if offset:Dot(offset) > BROAD_RADIUS * BROAD_RADIUS then
				continue
			end
		end

		for name, earlierFrame in earlier.parts do
			if name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
				continue -- overlaps the torso; counting it would double the hitbox
			end
			local laterFrame = later.parts[name]
			local size = track.sizes[name]
			if laterFrame == nil or size == nil then
				continue
			end
			local frame = if alpha > 0 then earlierFrame:Lerp(laterFrame, alpha) else earlierFrame
			local distance = rayBox(origin, direction, frame, size, bestDistance)
			if distance and distance < bestDistance then
				bestDistance = distance
				best = {
					character = track.character,
					humanoid = track.humanoid,
					player = track.player,
					part = name,
					distance = distance,
					position = origin + direction * distance,
				}
			end
		end
	end

	return best
end

-- The rewound boxes of one character, for the debug visualiser.
function LagCompensation.boxes(player: Player, time: number): { { cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3 } }
	local track = tracks[player]
	local boxes = {}
	if track == nil or #track.frames == 0 then
		return boxes
	end
	local earlier, later, alpha = bracket(track.frames, time)
	for name, earlierFrame in earlier.parts do
		local laterFrame = later.parts[name]
		local size = track.sizes[name]
		if laterFrame and size and name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			table.insert(boxes, { cframe = earlierFrame:Lerp(laterFrame, alpha), size = size })
		end
	end
	return boxes
end

return LagCompensation

--!strict
--[[
	Server entry point. RunContext = Server, so it runs from wherever the
	Ordnance object lives; there is nothing to install in ServerScriptService.

	Requiring the public module is what starts the framework, so a game script
	that requires Ordnance first gets a started framework too.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

if RunService:IsRunning() then
	require(script.Parent.Parent.Parent)
end

--!strict
--[[
	Sessions
	What the server knows about each player: which weapons they carry, the
	authoritative state of each, and which one is in their hands.

	In the default "Tool" inventory mode every weapon is a Backpack Tool built
	from the weapon's model, so equipping, the hotbar, mobile and gamepad all
	work the way players already expect. In "Custom" mode nothing is handed
	out; the game calls Ordnance.Equip itself.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Framework = script.Parent.Parent

local Config = require(Framework.Config)
local Events = require(Framework.Core.Events)
local Logger = require(Framework.Core.Logger)
local Net = require(Framework.Core.Net)
local Registry = require(Framework.Weapons.Registry)
local Rig = require(Framework.Weapons.Rig)
local State = require(Framework.Weapons.State)

export type Session = {
	player: Player,
	seed: number,
	states: { [string]: State.State },
	tools: { [string]: Tool },
	fitted: { [string]: { [string]: string } }, -- weapon id -> slot -> attachment id
	lights: { [string]: boolean }, -- weapon id -> light and laser switched on
	equipped: string?,
	heldModel: Model?, -- Custom mode only
	lastShotId: number,
	fireTokens: number,
	fireTime: number,
}

local WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE = Registry.WeaponAttribute
local FITTED_ATTRIBUTE = Registry.FittedAttribute
local LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE = "OrdnanceLight"

local log = Logger.scope("Sessions")

local Sessions = {}

Sessions.WeaponAttribute = WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE
Sessions.LightAttribute = LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE

local sessions: { [Player]: Session } = {}
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local characterConnections: { [Player]: RBXScriptConnection } = {}
local seedSource = Random.new()

local function now(): number
	return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
end

function Sessions.get(player: Player): Session?
	return sessions[player]
end

-- A player's weapon with their attachments fitted. Everything the server
-- checks (rate of fire, spread, damage) is read from this.
function Sessions.entryOf(session: Session, id: string): Registry.Entry?
	local base = Registry.get(id)
	if base == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local fitted = session.fitted[id]
	if fitted == nil then
		fitted = Registry.defaults(base)
		session.fitted[id] = fitted
	end
	return Registry.variant(id, fitted)
end

-- The authoritative state of a weapon, created full on first use.
function Sessions.state(session: Session, entry: Registry.Entry): State.State
	local state = session.states[entry.id]
	if state == nil then
		state = State.new(entry.config, now())
		session.states[entry.id] = state
	end
	return state
end

-- Sends the client the server's view of a weapon.
function Sessions.sync(session: Session, id: string)
	local state = session.states[id]
	if state then
		Net.fireClient(session.player, "Sync", id, State.snapshot(state, now()), session.seed)
	end
end

local function onEquipped(session: Session, entry: Registry.Entry)
	session.equipped = entry.id
	local state = Sessions.state(session, entry)
	State.equip(state, entry.config, now())
	-- A fresh allowance so the first shots after a swap are never throttled.
	session.fireTokens = 3
	session.fireTime = os.clock()
	Sessions.sync(session, entry.id)
	Events.Equipped:Fire(session.player, entry.id)
end

local function onUnequipped(session: Session, id: string)
	if session.equipped ~= id then
		return
	end
	session.equipped = nil
	local state = session.states[id]
	if state and state.action == "Reload" then
		state.action = "Idle" -- putting the weapon away abandons the reload
	end
	Events.Unequipped:Fire(session.player, id)
end

local function buildTool(session: Session, entry: Registry.Entry): Tool
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = entry.config.Name
	tool.ToolTip = entry.config.Description
	tool.CanBeDropped = false
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool:SetAttribute(WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE, entry.id)
	tool:SetAttribute(FITTED_ATTRIBUTE, entry.key)
	tool:SetAttribute(LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE, session.lights[entry.id] == true)

	local model = entry.template:Clone()
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	tool.Grip = Rig.gripCFrame(model)
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	for _, child in model:GetChildren() do
		child.Parent = tool
	end
	model:Destroy()

	tool.Equipped:Connect(log:Wrap(function()
		onEquipped(session, entry)
	end))
	tool.Unequipped:Connect(log:Wrap(function()
		onUnequipped(session, entry.id)
	end))
	return tool
end

-- Adds a weapon to the player's inventory. In Tool mode this puts a Tool in
-- their Backpack. Returns false if the weapon does not exist.
function Sessions.give(player: Player, id: string): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session == nil then
		return false
	end
	local entry = Sessions.entryOf(session, id)
	if entry == nil then
		log:Warn(`cannot give "{id}" to {player.Name}: no weapon has that name`)
		return false
	end
	Sessions.state(session, entry)

	if Config.global().Inventory.Mode ~= "Tool" then
		return true
	end
	local existing = session.tools[id]
	if existing and existing.Parent ~= nil then
		return true
	end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack == nil then
		return false
	end
	local tool = buildTool(session, entry)
	session.tools[id] = tool
	tool.Parent = backpack
	return true
end

function Sessions.take(player: Player, id: string)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session == nil then
		return
	end
	if session.equipped == id then
		Sessions.unequip(player)
	end
	local tool = session.tools[id]
	if tool then
		tool:Destroy()
		session.tools[id] = nil
	end
	session.states[id] = nil
end

local function removeHeldModel(session: Session)
	if session.heldModel then
		session.heldModel:Destroy()
		session.heldModel = nil
	end
end

-- Puts a weapon in the player's hands. In Tool mode this equips the Tool; in
-- Custom mode it welds the weapon model to the character.
function Sessions.equip(player: Player, id: string): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	local entry = if session then Sessions.entryOf(session, id) else nil
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if session == nil or entry == nil or character == nil or humanoid == nil then
		return false
	end

	if Config.global().Inventory.Mode == "Tool" then
		if not Sessions.give(player, id) then
			return false
		end
		humanoid:EquipTool(session.tools[id])
		return true
	end

	Sessions.unequip(player)
	local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	if hand == nil or not hand:IsA("BasePart") then
		log:Warn(`cannot equip "{id}" on {player.Name}: the character has no right hand`)
		return false
	end

	local model = entry.template:Clone()
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local handGrip = hand:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment")
	local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	motor.Name = "OrdnanceGrip"
	motor.Part0 = hand
	motor.Part1 = handle
	motor.C0 = if handGrip and handGrip:IsA("Attachment") then handGrip.CFrame else CFrame.identity
	motor.C1 = Rig.gripCFrame(model)
	motor.Parent = handle
	model:SetAttribute(WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE, id)
	model:SetAttribute(FITTED_ATTRIBUTE, entry.key)
	model:SetAttribute(LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE, session.lights[id] == true)
	model.Parent = character
	session.heldModel = model

	Net.fireClient(player, "Equip", id)
	onEquipped(session, entry)
	return true
end

function Sessions.unequip(player: Player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session == nil then
		return
	end
	local id = session.equipped
	if Config.global().Inventory.Mode == "Tool" then
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
		end
		return
	end
	removeHeldModel(session)
	if id then
		Net.fireClient(player, "Equip", nil)
		onUnequipped(session, id)
	end
end

--[[
	Fits an attachment to one of a player's weapons, or empties the slot when
	`attachmentId` is nil. The weapon is rebuilt with it, in their hands if it
	was there. Returns false if the weapon cannot take it.
]]
function Sessions.setAttachment(player: Player, id: string, slot: string, attachmentId: string?): boolean
	local session = sessions[player]
	local base = Registry.get(id)
	if session == nil or base == nil then
		return false
	end
	if attachmentId ~= nil and not Registry.accepts(base, slot, attachmentId) then
		return false
	end
	local current = Sessions.entryOf(session, id)
	local fitted = table.clone(if current then current.fitted else {})
	if fitted[slot] == attachmentId then
		return true
	end
	fitted[slot] = attachmentId
	session.fitted[id] = fitted
	local entry = Sessions.entryOf(session, id) :: Registry.Entry

	-- A smaller magazine cannot hold what the old one did.
	local state = session.states[id]
	if state and state.mag > entry.config.Ammo.Magazine then
		state.reserve += state.mag - entry.config.Ammo.Magazine
		state.mag = entry.config.Ammo.Magazine
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if Config.global().Inventory.Mode == "Tool" then
		local old = session.tools[id]
		if old and old.Parent ~= nil then
			local held = old.Parent == character
			local tool = buildTool(session, entry)
			session.tools[id] = tool
			local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			if held and humanoid then
				old:Destroy()
				tool.Parent = backpack
				humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
			else
				tool.Parent = old.Parent
				old:Destroy()
			end
		end
	elseif session.equipped == id then
		Sessions.equip(player, id)
	end
	if session.equipped == id then
		Sessions.sync(session, id)
	end
	return true
end

-- What is fitted to a player's weapon: slot -> attachment id.
function Sessions.getAttachments(player: Player, id: string): { [string]: string }
	local session = sessions[player]
	local entry = if session then Sessions.entryOf(session, id) else nil
	return if entry then table.clone(entry.fitted) else {}
end

-- Switches the lights and lasers on the weapon in a player's hands.
function Sessions.toggleLight(player: Player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	local id = if session then session.equipped else nil
	if session == nil or id == nil then
		return
	end
	local on = not session.lights[id]
	session.lights[id] = on
	local holder: Instance? = if Config.global().Inventory.Mode == "Tool"
		then session.tools[id]
		else session.heldModel
	if holder then
		holder:SetAttribute(LIGHT_ATTRIBUTE, on)
	end
end

local function giveLoadout(player: Player)
	local inventory = Config.global().Inventory
	if inventory.Mode ~= "Tool" or not inventory.GiveOnSpawn then
		return
	end
	local ids = if table.find(inventory.Loadout, "*") then Registry.ids() else inventory.Loadout
	for _, id in ids do
		Sessions.give(player, id)
	end
end

local function onCharacter(player: Player)
	local session = sessions[player]
	if session == nil then
		return
	end
	-- A new life starts with full weapons and nothing in hand.
	table.clear(session.states)
	table.clear(session.tools)
	session.equipped = nil
	session.heldModel = nil
	giveLoadout(player)
end

local function onPlayer(player: Player)
	sessions[player] = {
		player = player,
		seed = seedSource:NextInteger(1, 2 ^ 30),
		states = {},
		tools = {},
		fitted = {},
		lights = {},
		equipped = nil,
		heldModel = nil,
		lastShotId = 0,
		fireTokens = 3,
		fireTime = os.clock(),
	}
	characterConnections[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(log:Wrap(function()
		onCharacter(player)
	end))
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local connection = characterConnections[player]
	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
		characterConnections[player] = nil
	end
	sessions[player] = nil
end

function Sessions.start()
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(log:Wrap(onPlayer)))
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(log:Wrap(onPlayerRemoving)))
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		log:Try(onPlayer, player)
	end
end

function Sessions.stop()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	for player, session in sessions do
		for _, tool in session.tools do
			tool:Destroy()
		end
		removeHeldModel(session)
		local connection = characterConnections[player]
		if connection then
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	table.clear(characterConnections)
	table.clear(sessions)
end

return Sessions

-- tools/bundle.mjs and the release workflow read this line; keep the format.
