--!strict
--[[
	Attachments
	Finds the attachment modules in Ordnance.Attachments and gets each one
	ready: checks its settings and prepares its model.

	An attachment is a ModuleScript with its model inside it, like a weapon:

		return {
			Name = "Aimpoint CompM4",
			Slot = "Optic",                          -- Optic, Muzzle, Underbarrel or Side
			Config = { Handling = { AimFOV = 55 } }, -- weapon settings it changes
			Tuning = { Recoil = 0.9 },               -- multiplied onto the weapon's
		}

	Optional behaviour: Light (a flashlight), Laser (a laser sight) and Scope
	(a full-screen scope picture when aimed). See the docs for their fields.

	The model faces the same way as a weapon (front -Z, top +Y) and may mark:
		Mount     where it meets the weapon
		Aim       the sight line through an optic
		Barrel    the new muzzle, on a muzzle device
		Grip      where the support hand holds, on a grip
		Emitter   where a light or laser shines from, facing forward
	Anything missing is worked out from the model's shape.
]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Logger = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Logger)

local log = Logger.scope("Attachments")

export type Slot = "Optic" | "Muzzle" | "Underbarrel" | "Side"

export type Light = {
	Brightness: number,
	Range: number,
	Angle: number,
	Color: Color3,
}

export type Laser = {
	Color: Color3,
	Width: number,
	Range: number,
}

export type Scope = {
	Reticle: Color3,
	Overlay: Color3,
}

export type Definition = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	slot: Slot,
	module: ModuleScript,
	template: Model, -- prepared: a Handle, and every marker attachment present
	config: { [string]: any }?, -- checked partial weapon config
	tuning: { [string]: number }?,
	scale: number,
	light: Light?,
	laser: Laser?,
	scope: Scope?,
}

local Attachments = {}

Attachments.Slots = table.freeze({ "Optic", "Muzzle", "Underbarrel", "Side" } :: { Slot })

local definitions: { [string]: Definition } = {}
local order: { string } = {}

local LIGHT_DEFAULTS: Light = {
	Brightness = 4,
	Range = 45,
	Angle = 50,
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 230),
}
local LASER_DEFAULTS: Laser = {
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40),
	Width = 0.03,
	Range = 300,
}
local SCOPE_DEFAULTS: Scope = {
	Reticle = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10),
	Overlay = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
}

-- Fills in a behaviour table from its defaults, keeping only known fields of the right type.
local function behaviour<T>(id: string, field: string, value: any, defaults: T): T?
	if value == nil or value == false then
		return nil
	end
	local result = table.clone(defaults :: any)
	if type(value) == "table" then
		for key, item in value do
			local default = (defaults :: any)[key]
			if default == nil then
				log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": {field}.{tostring(key)} is not a setting`)
			elseif typeof(item) ~= typeof(default) then
				log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": {field}.{key} should be a {typeof(default)}`)
			else
				result[key] = item
			end
		end
	end
	return result :: any
end

-- The box around every part of `model`, in `frame`'s space.
function Attachments.bounds(model: Instance, frame: CFrame): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local low = Vector3.one * math.huge
	local high = -low
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then
			local local_ = frame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
			local half = part.Size / 2
			for _, corner in
				{
					Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
					Vector3.new(1, 1, -1),
					Vector3.new(1, -1, 1),
					Vector3.new(1, -1, -1),
					Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1),
					Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1),
					Vector3.new(-1, -1, 1),
					Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1),
				}
			do
				local point = local_ * (half * corner)
				low = low:Min(point)
				high = high:Max(point)
			end
		end
	end
	if low.X == math.huge then
		return Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	end
	return low, high
end

local function findHandle(model: Model): BasePart?
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		return model.PrimaryPart
	end
	local named = model:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
	if named and named:IsA("BasePart") then
		return named
	end
	local largest: BasePart? = nil
	local volume = -1
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local size = part.Size.X * part.Size.Y * part.Size.Z
			if size > volume then
				largest = part
				volume = size
			end
		end
	end
	return largest
end

local function marker(model: Instance, name: string): Attachment?
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Attachment") and descendant.Name == name then
			return descendant
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function addMarker(handle: BasePart, name: string, frame: CFrame)
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = name
	attachment.CFrame = frame
	attachment.Parent = handle
end

-- Copies the model and adds any markers it is missing.
local function prepare(source: Instance, id: string, slot: Slot, scale: number): Model?
	local model: Model
	if source:IsA("Model") then
		model = source:Clone()
	elseif source:IsA("BasePart") then
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		source:Clone().Parent = model
	else
		log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": the model is a {source.ClassName}; use a Model or a part`)
		return nil
	end
	local handle = findHandle(model)
	if handle == nil then
		log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": the model has no parts`)
		model:Destroy()
		return nil
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = handle
	model.Name = id
	if scale ~= 1 then
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * scale)
	end
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.Massless = true
		end
	end

	local low, high = Attachments.bounds(model, handle.CFrame)
	local centre = (low + high) / 2
	local size = high - low

	-- Where it meets the weapon: the face that sits against it.
	if marker(model, "Mount") == nil then
		local mount = if slot == "Optic"
			then Vector3.new(centre.X, low.Y, centre.Z)
			elseif slot == "Muzzle" then Vector3.new(centre.X, centre.Y, high.Z)
			elseif slot == "Underbarrel" then Vector3.new(centre.X, high.Y, centre.Z)
			else Vector3.new(low.X, centre.Y, centre.Z)
		addMarker(handle, "Mount", CFrame.new(mount))
	end
	if slot == "Optic" and marker(model, "Aim") == nil then
		-- The window of a sight is a little above the middle, at the back.
		addMarker(handle, "Aim", CFrame.new(centre.X, low.Y + size.Y * 0.62, high.Z))
	end
	if slot == "Muzzle" and marker(model, "Barrel") == nil then
		addMarker(handle, "Barrel", CFrame.new(centre.X, centre.Y, low.Z))
	end
	if slot == "Underbarrel" and marker(model, "Grip") == nil then
		addMarker(handle, "Grip", CFrame.new(centre.X, low.Y + size.Y * 0.45, centre.Z))
	end
	if slot == "Side" and marker(model, "Emitter") == nil then
		addMarker(handle, "Emitter", CFrame.new(centre.X, centre.Y, low.Z))
	end
	return model
end

local function findModel(module: ModuleScript, setting: any): Instance?
	if typeof(setting) == "Instance" then
		return setting
	end
	if type(setting) == "string" then
		local named = module:FindFirstChild(setting)
		if named then
			return named
		end
	end
	for _, child in module:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
			return child
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function load(module: ModuleScript)
	local id = module.Name
	if definitions[id] then
		log:Warn(`two attachments are named "{id}"; keeping the first`)
		return
	end
	local ok, definition = pcall(require, module)
	if not ok or type(definition) ~= "table" then
		log:Error(
			`attachment "{id}" failed to load: {if ok then "it must return a table" else tostring(definition)}`
		)
		return
	end

	local slot = definition.Slot
	if not table.find(Attachments.Slots, slot) then
		log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": Slot must be one of {table.concat(Attachments.Slots, ", ")}; skipped`)
		return
	end

	local config: { [string]: any }? = nil
	if definition.Config ~= nil then
		local clean, problems = Config.Schema.validate(definition.Config, "Weapon")
		for _, problem in problems do
			log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": Config.{problem.path} {problem.message}`)
		end
		for _, key in { "Name", "Description", "Model", "Scale", "Custom", "Animations", "Attachments" } do
			if clean[key] ~= nil then
				clean[key] = nil
				log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": Config.{key} cannot be changed by an attachment`)
			end
		end
		config = clean
	end

	local tuning: { [string]: number }? = nil
	if definition.Tuning ~= nil then
		local clean, problems = Config.Schema.validate({ Tuning = definition.Tuning }, "Weapon")
		for _, problem in problems do
			log:Warn(`attachment "{id}": {problem.path} {problem.message}`)
		end
		tuning = clean.Tuning
	end

	local scale = if type(definition.Scale) == "number" and definition.Scale > 0 then definition.Scale else 1
	local source = findModel(module, definition.Model or "Model")
	if source == nil then
		log:Warn(`attachment "{id}" has no model; skipped. Put a Model inside the module.`)
		return
	end
	local template = prepare(source, id, slot, scale)
	if template == nil then
		return
	end

	local light = behaviour(id, "Light", definition.Light, LIGHT_DEFAULTS)
	if light then
		-- One SpotLight per Emitter, off until the player switches it on.
		for _, emitter in template:GetDescendants() do
			if emitter:IsA("Attachment") and emitter.Name == "Emitter" then
				local spot = Instance.new("SpotLight")
				spot.Brightness = light.Brightness
				spot.Range = light.Range
				spot.Angle = light.Angle
				spot.Color = light.Color
				spot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
				spot.Shadows = true
				spot.Enabled = false
				spot.Parent = emitter
			end
		end
	end

	definitions[id] = {
		id = id,
		name = if type(definition.Name) == "string" and definition.Name ~= "" then definition.Name else id,
		slot = slot,
		module = module,
		template = template,
		config = config,
		tuning = tuning,
		scale = scale,
		light = light,
		laser = behaviour(id, "Laser", definition.Laser, LASER_DEFAULTS),
		scope = behaviour(id, "Scope", definition.Scope, SCOPE_DEFAULTS),
	}
	table.insert(order, id)
end

local function scan(container: Instance)
	for _, child in container:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			log:Try(load, child)
		elseif child:IsA("Folder") then
			scan(child)
		end
	end
end

-- Loads every attachment under `root.Attachments`. Calling it again reloads.
function Attachments.load(root: Instance)
	for _, definition in definitions do
		definition.template:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(definitions)
	table.clear(order)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild("Attachments")
	if folder == nil then
		return
	end
	scan(folder)
	table.sort(order)
	if #order > 0 then
		log:Info(`{#order} attachment{if #order == 1 then "" else "s"} ready`)
	end
end

function Attachments.get(id: string): Definition?
	return definitions[id]
end

-- Attachment ids in alphabetical order, optionally only those for one slot.
function Attachments.ids(slot: Slot?): { string }
	local result = {}
	for _, id in order do
		if slot == nil or definitions[id].slot == slot then
			table.insert(result, id)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- "Muzzle=Suppressor;Optic=RedDot": a stable text form of what is fitted.
function Attachments.encode(fitted: { [string]: string }): string
	local parts = {}
	for _, slot in Attachments.Slots do
		local id = fitted[slot]
		if id then
			table.insert(parts, `{slot}={id}`)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ";")
end

function Attachments.decode(text: any): { [string]: string }
	local fitted = {}
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		return fitted
	end
	for slot, id in string.gmatch(text, "(%w+)=([^;]+)") do
		if table.find(Attachments.Slots, slot :: any) then
			fitted[slot] = id
		end
	end
	return fitted
end

return Attachments

--!strict
--[[
	Registry
	Finds the weapon modules in Ordnance.Weapons and gets each one ready:
	loads it, resolves its config and prepares its model.

	A weapon is a ModuleScript that returns a table. Folders inside Weapons are
	only for organising; ModuleScripts inside a weapon module belong to that
	weapon and are not weapons themselves.

	A weapon with attachments fitted is a variant: its own config (the
	attachments' settings laid over the weapon's) and its own model (the
	attachment models mounted on it). Variants are built when first asked for
	and kept. The server and every client build the same variant from the
	same short key, so only the key is ever sent.

	A weapon that fails to load is reported and skipped. It never stops the
	others from loading.
]]

local Attachments = require(script.Parent.Attachments)
local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Logger = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Logger)
local Rig = require(script.Parent.Rig)

export type Gadgets = {
	light: Attachments.Light?,
	laser: Attachments.Laser?,
	scope: Attachments.Scope?,
}

export type Entry = {
	id: string,
	module: ModuleScript,
	config: Config.Config,
	template: Model,
	definition: { [string]: any }, -- the module's table
	fitted: { [string]: string }, -- slot -> attachment id
	key: string, -- Attachments.encode(fitted); "" for the bare weapon
	gadgets: Gadgets,
}

local WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE = "OrdnanceWeapon"
local FITTED_ATTRIBUTE = "OrdnanceAttachments"

local log = Logger.scope("Registry")

local Registry = {}

Registry.WeaponAttribute = WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE
Registry.FittedAttribute = FITTED_ATTRIBUTE

local entries: { [string]: Entry } = {}
local variants: { [string]: Entry } = {}
local order: { string } = {}

local function findModel(module: ModuleScript, setting: any): Instance?
	if typeof(setting) == "Instance" then
		return setting
	end
	if type(setting) == "string" then
		local named = module:FindFirstChild(setting)
		if named then
			return named
		end
	end
	for _, child in module:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
			return child
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadWeapon(module: ModuleScript)
	local id = module.Name
	if entries[id] then
		log:Warn(`two weapons are named "{id}"; keeping the first, skipping {module:GetFullName()}`)
		return
	end

	local ok, definition = pcall(require, module)
	if not ok then
		log:Error(`weapon "{id}" failed to load: {tostring(definition)}`)
		return
	end
	if type(definition) ~= "table" then
		log:Error(`weapon "{id}" must return a table, got {typeof(definition)}`)
		return
	end

	local config = Config.weapon(id, definition)
	local source = findModel(module, config.Model)
	if source == nil then
		log:Warn(`weapon "{id}" has no model; using a placeholder. Put a Model inside the module.`)
	end

	entries[id] = {
		id = id,
		module = module,
		config = config,
		template = Rig.prepare(source, id, config.Scale),
		definition = definition,
		fitted = {},
		key = "",
		gadgets = { scope = if config.Scope.Enabled then config.Scope :: any else nil },
	}
	table.insert(order, id)
end

local function scan(container: Instance)
	for _, child in container:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			log:Try(loadWeapon, child)
		elseif child:IsA("Folder") then
			scan(child)
		end
	end
end

-- Loads every weapon under `root.Weapons` and every attachment under
-- `root.Attachments`. Calling it again reloads.
function Registry.load(root: Instance)
	for _, entry in entries do
		entry.template:Destroy()
	end
	for _, entry in variants do
		entry.template:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(entries)
	table.clear(variants)
	table.clear(order)

	Attachments.load(root)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	if folder == nil then
		log:Warn("Ordnance.Weapons is missing; no weapons loaded")
		return
	end
	scan(folder)
	table.sort(order)
	log:Info(`{#order} weapon{if #order == 1 then "" else "s"} ready`)
end

-- The bare weapon, with nothing fitted.
function Registry.get(id: string): Entry?
	return entries[id]
end

-- Weapon ids in alphabetical order.
function Registry.ids(): { string }
	return table.clone(order)
end

-- Whether `attachmentId` may be fitted to a weapon in `slot`.
function Registry.accepts(entry: Entry, slot: string, attachmentId: string): boolean
	local attachment = Attachments.get(attachmentId)
	if attachment == nil or attachment.slot ~= slot then
		return false
	end
	local allowed = (entry.config.Attachments.Allowed :: any)[slot]
	if type(allowed) ~= "table" then
		return true
	end
	return table.find(allowed, attachmentId) ~= nil or table.find(allowed, "*") ~= nil
end

-- Every attachment id a weapon accepts in `slot`.
function Registry.options(entry: Entry, slot: string): { string }
	local result = {}
	for _, id in Attachments.ids(slot :: any) do
		if Registry.accepts(entry, slot, id) then
			table.insert(result, id)
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- What a weapon comes with: its Attachments.Default, minus anything it cannot take.
function Registry.defaults(entry: Entry): { [string]: string }
	local fitted = {}
	for slot, id in entry.config.Attachments.Default :: any do
		if type(slot) == "string" and type(id) == "string" then
			if Registry.accepts(entry, slot, id) then
				fitted[slot] = id
			else
				log:WarnOnce(
					`default:{entry.id}:{slot}`,
					`weapon "{entry.id}": the default {slot} "{id}" does not exist or does not fit`
				)
			end
		end
	end
	return fitted
end

-- A weapon with attachments fitted. Attachments that do not fit are left off.
function Registry.variant(id: string, fitted: { [string]: string }?): Entry?
	local base = entries[id]
	if base == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local clean = {}
	for slot, attachmentId in fitted or {} do
		if Registry.accepts(base, slot, attachmentId) then
			clean[slot] = attachmentId
		end
	end
	local key = Attachments.encode(clean)
	if key == "" then
		return base
	end
	local cacheKey = `{id}|{key}`
	local cached = variants[cacheKey]
	if cached then
		return cached
	end

	local layers: { Config.Layer } = {}
	local gadgets: Gadgets = {}
	local template = base.template:Clone()
	local ownScope = base.gadgets.scope
	for _, slot in Attachments.Slots do
		local attachmentId = clean[slot]
		local attachment = if attachmentId then Attachments.get(attachmentId) else nil
		if attachment then
			table.insert(layers, { config = attachment.config, tuning = attachment.tuning })
			Rig.mount(template, slot, attachment.template)
			gadgets.light = gadgets.light or attachment.light
			gadgets.laser = gadgets.laser or attachment.laser
			gadgets.scope = gadgets.scope or attachment.scope
		end
	end

	if gadgets.scope == nil and clean.Optic == nil then
		gadgets.scope = ownScope -- a built-in scope, unless an optic replaced it
	end

	local entry: Entry = {
		id = id,
		module = base.module,
		config = Config.weapon(id, base.definition, layers, true),
		template = template,
		definition = base.definition,
		fitted = clean,
		key = key,
		gadgets = gadgets,
	}
	variants[cacheKey] = entry
	return entry
end

-- The weapon a Tool or held model is, with whatever is fitted to it.
function Registry.entryFor(instance: Instance): Entry?
	local id = instance:GetAttribute(WEAPON_ATTRIBUTE)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return Registry.variant(id, Attachments.decode(instance:GetAttribute(FITTED_ATTRIBUTE)))
end

return Registry

--!strict
--[[
	Rig
	Turns whatever model a weapon ships with into something the framework can
	hold, weld and fire from.

	A weapon model needs very little:
	  - a part named "Handle" (or a PrimaryPart). Its front face (-Z) points
	    down the barrel and its top face (+Y) points up.
	  - optionally, attachments on the handle:
	        MainHandle   where the trigger hand holds
	        Barrel       the muzzle
	        Grip         where the support hand holds
	        Side         a second support-hand spot (bolt, charging handle)
	        Mag          the magazine
	Anything missing is worked out from the geometry, and every other part is
	welded to the handle here, so models do not need welds of their own.
]]

local Logger = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.Logger)

local log = Logger.scope("Rig")

local Rig = {}

Rig.Attachments = table.freeze({ "MainHandle", "Barrel", "Grip", "Side", "Mag" })

local HANDLE_NAMES = { "Handle", "MainHandle" }

local function findHandle(model: Model): BasePart?
	if model.PrimaryPart then
		return model.PrimaryPart
	end
	for _, name in HANDLE_NAMES do
		local found = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
		if found and found:IsA("BasePart") then
			return found
		end
	end
	local largest: BasePart? = nil
	local largestVolume = -1
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			local volume = descendant.Size.X * descendant.Size.Y * descendant.Size.Z
			if volume > largestVolume then
				largest = descendant
				largestVolume = volume
			end
		end
	end
	return largest
end

-- How far a part reaches along `axis` from its centre.
local function reach(part: BasePart, axis: Vector3): number
	local frame = part.CFrame
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(frame.RightVector:Dot(axis)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(frame.UpVector:Dot(axis)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(frame.LookVector:Dot(axis)) * half.Z
end

-- The point furthest forward on the model, in the handle's space.
local function estimateMuzzle(model: Model, handle: BasePart): Vector3
	local forward = handle.CFrame.LookVector
	local bestTip = -math.huge
	local bestPoint = handle.Position
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			local extent = reach(descendant, forward)
			local tip = (descendant.Position - handle.Position):Dot(forward) + extent
			if tip > bestTip then
				bestTip = tip
				bestPoint = descendant.Position + forward * extent
			end
		end
	end
	return handle.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(bestPoint)
end

-- A plain block gun, used when a weapon module has no model at all.
function Rig.placeholder(): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Placeholder"

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.28, 0.8, 0.34)
	handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 43, 40)
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	handle.Parent = model

	local body = Instance.new("Part")
	body.Name = "Body"
	body.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.36, 1.9)
	body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(58, 60, 55)
	body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	body.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -0.6)
	body.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = handle
	return model
end

-- Finds an attachment on the weapon by name, wherever it was put.
function Rig.attachment(model: Instance, name: string): Attachment?
	-- A part and the joint that holds it often share an attachment's name
	-- ("Mag", "Barrel"), so match on class as well as name.
	local alias = if name == "Barrel" then "Muzzle" else nil
	local aliased: Attachment? = nil
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Attachment") then
			if descendant.Name == name then
				return descendant
			elseif descendant.Name == alias then
				aliased = descendant
			end
		end
	end
	return aliased
end

--[[
	Returns a prepared copy of `source`: unanchored, non-colliding, welded to
	its handle, with MainHandle and Barrel attachments guaranteed. The source
	is not modified. Never fails; a hopeless model becomes the placeholder.
]]
function Rig.prepare(source: Instance?, weaponName: string, scale: number?): Model
	local model: Model
	if source == nil then
		model = Rig.placeholder()
	elseif source:IsA("Model") then
		model = source:Clone()
	elseif source:IsA("BasePart") then
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		local part = source:Clone()
		part.Parent = model
		model.PrimaryPart = part
	elseif source:IsA("Tool") or source:IsA("Folder") then
		model = Instance.new("Model")
		for _, child in source:GetChildren() do
			child:Clone().Parent = model
		end
	else
		log:Warn(`{weaponName}: the model is a {source.ClassName}, which cannot be held; using a placeholder`)
		model = Rig.placeholder()
	end

	local handle = findHandle(model)
	if handle == nil then
		log:Warn(`{weaponName}: the model has no parts; using a placeholder`)
		model:Destroy()
		model = Rig.placeholder()
		handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	elseif model.PrimaryPart == nil and not table.find(HANDLE_NAMES, handle.Name) then
		log:Warn(
			`{weaponName}: no part named "Handle"; using the largest part, "{handle.Name}". The grip may look off.`
		)
	end
	model.Name = weaponName
	model.PrimaryPart = handle
	if scale and scale ~= 1 then
		-- Scales parts, meshes, attachments and joint offsets together.
		model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * scale)
	end

	-- Parts already held by a joint keep it (moving parts rigged by hand).
	local jointed: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("JointInstance") or descendant:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			local joint = descendant :: any
			if joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
				jointed[joint.Part0] = true
				jointed[joint.Part1] = true
			end
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in model:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.Anchored = false
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
			descendant.CanQuery = false
			descendant.Massless = true
			if descendant ~= handle and not jointed[descendant] then
				-- A Motor6D rather than a weld, so the part can be animated
				-- through its Transform. It is named after the part it holds.
				local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
				joint.Name = descendant.Name
				joint.Part0 = handle
				joint.Part1 = descendant
				joint.C0 = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(descendant.CFrame)
				joint.Parent = handle
			end
		end
	end

	if Rig.attachment(model, "MainHandle") == nil then
		local grip = Instance.new("Attachment")
		grip.Name = "MainHandle"
		grip.Parent = handle
	end
	if Rig.attachment(model, "Barrel") == nil then
		local barrel = Instance.new("Attachment")
		barrel.Name = "Barrel"
		barrel.Position = estimateMuzzle(model, handle)
		barrel.Parent = handle
	end

	return model
end

--[[
	Attachment mounts. A weapon can mark where each slot sits with an
	attachment named OpticMount, MuzzleMount, UnderMount or SideMount (front
	-Z, top +Y, like the handle). Without one, the place is worked out from
	the model's shape:
	  Optic        on top of the receiver, a little ahead of the grip
	  Muzzle       at the Barrel attachment
	  Underbarrel  under the handguard
	  Side         on the right of the handguard
]]
Rig.Mounts = table.freeze({
	Optic = "OpticMount",
	Muzzle = "MuzzleMount",
	Underbarrel = "UnderMount",
	Side = "SideMount",
})

type Box = { low: Vector3, high: Vector3, name: string }

local function partBoxes(model: Model, frame: CFrame): { Box }
	local boxes = {}
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 then
			local local_ = frame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
			local half = part.Size / 2
			local extent = Vector3.new(
				math.abs(local_.XVector.X) * half.X
					+ math.abs(local_.YVector.X) * half.Y
					+ math.abs(local_.ZVector.X) * half.Z,
				math.abs(local_.XVector.Y) * half.X
					+ math.abs(local_.YVector.Y) * half.Y
					+ math.abs(local_.ZVector.Y) * half.Z,
				math.abs(local_.XVector.Z) * half.X
					+ math.abs(local_.YVector.Z) * half.Y
					+ math.abs(local_.ZVector.Z) * half.Z
			)
			table.insert(
				boxes,
				{ low = local_.Position - extent, high = local_.Position + extent, name = part.Name }
			)
		end
	end
	return boxes
end

-- Where `slot` sits on a prepared weapon model, in the handle's space.
function Rig.mountPoint(model: Model, slot: string): CFrame
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local named = Rig.attachment(model, (Rig.Mounts :: any)[slot] or "")
	if named then
		return handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(named.WorldCFrame)
	end
	local barrelAttachment = Rig.attachment(model, "Barrel")
	local barrel = if barrelAttachment
		then handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(barrelAttachment.WorldCFrame).Position
		else Vector3.new(0, 0.5, -2)
	if slot == "Muzzle" then
		return CFrame.new(barrel)
	end

	local main = Rig.gripCFrame(model).Position
	local length = barrel.Z - main.Z -- negative: the barrel is forward
	local boxes = partBoxes(model, handle.CFrame)
	local function covering(z: number, needX: boolean): { Box }
		local found = {}
		for _, box in boxes do
			if
				box.low.Z <= z
				and box.high.Z >= z
				and (not needX or (box.low.X <= 0.02 and box.high.X >= -0.02))
			then
				if box.name ~= "Mag" then
					table.insert(found, box)
				end
			end
		end
		return found
	end

	if slot == "Optic" then
		local z = main.Z + length * 0.18
		local top = barrel.Y + 0.15
		for _, box in covering(z, true) do
			top = math.max(top, box.high.Y)
		end
		return CFrame.new(0, top, z)
	elseif slot == "Underbarrel" then
		local z = main.Z + length * 0.62
		local bottom = barrel.Y - 0.1
		for _, box in covering(z, true) do
			if box.high.Y > barrel.Y - 0.6 then -- the handguard, not something hanging far below
				bottom = math.min(bottom, box.low.Y)
			end
		end
		return CFrame.new(0, bottom, z)
	end
	-- Side
	local z = main.Z + length * 0.58
	local right = 0.05
	for _, box in covering(z, false) do
		if box.low.Y <= barrel.Y and box.high.Y >= barrel.Y - 0.2 then
			right = math.max(right, box.high.X)
		end
	end
	return CFrame.new(right, barrel.Y - 0.08, z)
end

-- Names a fitted attachment can take over from the weapon: the optic's sight
-- line, the muzzle device's muzzle, the grip's hand position.
local TAKES_OVER = { Aim = "IronAim", Barrel = "BaseBarrel", Muzzle = "BaseMuzzle", Grip = "BaseGrip" }

--[[
	Fits an attachment model to a prepared weapon model (changing it) and
	returns the folder its parts went into. `template` is the attachment's
	prepared model; its Mount marker is placed on the weapon's mount point.
]]
function Rig.mount(model: Model, slot: string, template: Model): Model
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local copy = template:Clone()
	local own = copy.PrimaryPart :: BasePart
	local mount: Attachment? = nil
	for _, descendant in copy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Attachment") and descendant.Name == "Mount" then
			mount = descendant
			break
		end
	end
	local mountLocal = if mount then own.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(mount.WorldCFrame) else CFrame.identity
	local target = handle.CFrame * Rig.mountPoint(model, slot) * mountLocal:Inverse()

	-- The attachment's own markers replace the weapon's.
	for _, descendant in copy:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("Attachment") then
			local replaced = TAKES_OVER[descendant.Name]
			if replaced then
				for _, existing in model:GetDescendants() do
					if existing:IsA("Attachment") and existing.Name == descendant.Name then
						existing.Name = replaced
					end
				end
				if descendant.Name == "Barrel" then
					-- "Muzzle" is also read as the muzzle; retire it too.
					for _, existing in model:GetDescendants() do
						if existing:IsA("Attachment") and existing.Name == "Muzzle" then
							existing.Name = "BaseMuzzle"
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local folder = Instance.new("Model")
	folder.Name = `Attachment{slot}`
	local origin = own.CFrame -- read once: the handle moves with the rest
	for _, part in copy:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local frame = target * origin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
			part.Parent = folder
			part.CFrame = frame
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.Massless = true
			for _, joint in part:GetChildren() do
				if joint:IsA("JointInstance") or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
					joint:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
			motor.Name = `{slot}{part.Name}`
			motor.Part0 = handle
			motor.Part1 = part
			motor.C0 = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(frame)
			motor.Parent = handle
		end
	end
	copy:Destroy()
	folder.Parent = model
	return folder
end

-- Where the trigger hand holds, relative to the handle part.
function Rig.gripCFrame(model: Model): CFrame
	local handle = model.PrimaryPart
	local grip = Rig.attachment(model, "MainHandle")
	if handle == nil or grip == nil then
		return CFrame.identity
	end
	return handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(grip.WorldCFrame)
end

return Rig

--!strict
--[[
	State
	The mechanical state of one weapon: rounds, chamber, fire mode and whatever
	action it is in the middle of. Pure data and pure functions, no instances
	and no timers.

	The client runs it to predict; the server runs the same code to decide.
	Time-based actions (equip, reload, cycle) are stored as a start and an end
	and resolved by `advance`, so neither side needs a timer and the server can
	forgive a little network delay by passing a tolerance.
]]

local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config.Defaults)

type Config = Defaults.Config

export type Action = "Idle" | "Equip" | "Reload" | "Cycle"

export type State = {
	mag: number,
	reserve: number,
	chambered: boolean,
	mode: string,
	action: Action,
	actionStart: number,
	actionEnd: number,
	shellsToLoad: number,
	shellsLoaded: number,
	needsCycle: boolean,
	jammed: boolean,
	nextFire: number,
	shots: number,
}

-- What travels in a Sync message.
export type Snapshot = { any }

local State = {}

local function isManual(config: Config): boolean
	return config.Fire.Action ~= "SelfLoading"
end

local function spend(state: State, config: Config, amount: number): number
	if config.Ammo.Infinite or state.reserve == math.huge then
		return amount
	end
	local taken = math.min(amount, state.reserve)
	state.reserve -= taken
	return taken
end

local function chamberFromMagazine(state: State, config: Config)
	if config.Realism.Chambering and not state.chambered and state.mag > 0 then
		state.mag -= 1
		state.chambered = true
	end
end

function State.new(config: Config, now: number): State
	local state: State = {
		mag = config.Ammo.Magazine,
		reserve = config.Ammo.Reserve,
		chambered = config.Realism.Chambering,
		mode = config.Fire.Mode,
		action = "Equip",
		actionStart = now,
		actionEnd = now + config.Handling.EquipTime,
		shellsToLoad = 0,
		shellsLoaded = 0,
		needsCycle = false,
		jammed = false,
		nextFire = 0,
		shots = 0,
	}
	return state
end

-- Rounds ready to fire without reloading.
function State.loaded(state: State): number
	return state.mag + (if state.chambered then 1 else 0)
end

function State.hasRound(state: State, config: Config): boolean
	if config.Realism.Chambering then
		return state.chambered
	end
	return state.mag > 0
end

-- Restarts the equip delay. Called every time the weapon is drawn.
function State.equip(state: State, config: Config, now: number)
	state.action = "Equip"
	state.actionStart = now
	state.actionEnd = now + config.Handling.EquipTime
	state.shellsToLoad = 0
	state.shellsLoaded = 0
end

local function finishMagazineReload(state: State, config: Config)
	if config.Realism.DropMagazine then
		state.mag = 0
	end
	state.mag += spend(state, config, config.Ammo.Magazine - state.mag)
	chamberFromMagazine(state, config)
	state.needsCycle = false
	state.jammed = false
end

--[[
	Brings the state up to `now`, completing any action that has finished.
	`tolerance` is the fraction of an action's length to forgive (0 to 1); the
	server passes Security.ReloadTolerance, the client passes 0.
]]
function State.advance(state: State, config: Config, now: number, tolerance: number?)
	local action = state.action
	if action == "Idle" then
		return
	end
	local scale = 1 - (tolerance or 0)
	local elapsed = now - state.actionStart

	if action == "Reload" and config.Ammo.ReloadType == "Single" then
		local shellTime = config.Ammo.ShellTime * scale
		local due = math.min(state.shellsToLoad, math.floor(elapsed / shellTime + 1e-4))
		while state.shellsLoaded < due do
			if spend(state, config, 1) < 1 then
				state.shellsToLoad = state.shellsLoaded
				break
			end
			state.mag += 1
			state.shellsLoaded += 1
		end
		if state.shellsLoaded >= state.shellsToLoad then
			chamberFromMagazine(state, config)
			state.needsCycle = false
			state.jammed = false
			state.action = "Idle"
		end
		return
	end

	if elapsed < (state.actionEnd - state.actionStart) * scale then
		return
	end

	if action == "Reload" then
		finishMagazineReload(state, config)
	elseif action == "Cycle" then
		state.needsCycle = false
		state.jammed = false
		chamberFromMagazine(state, config)
	end
	state.action = "Idle"
end

--[[
	Whether a shot may be fired right now, and if not, why:
	"Safe", "Busy", "Jammed", "NeedsCycle", "Empty" or "Rate".
	The server passes ignoreRate and checks cadence with its own allowance.
]]
function State.canFire(state: State, config: Config, now: number, ignoreRate: boolean?): (boolean, string?)
	if state.mode == "Safe" then
		return false, "Safe"
	end
	if state.action ~= "Idle" then
		-- A round-by-round reload can be cut short by firing.
		local interruptible = state.action == "Reload"
			and config.Ammo.ReloadType == "Single"
			and State.hasRound(state, config)
		if not interruptible then
			return false, "Busy"
		end
	end
	if state.jammed then
		return false, "Jammed"
	end
	if state.needsCycle then
		return false, "NeedsCycle"
	end
	if not State.hasRound(state, config) then
		return false, "Empty"
	end
	if not ignoreRate and now < state.nextFire - 1e-3 then
		return false, "Rate"
	end
	return true, nil
end

-- Seconds between shots in the current mode. Bursts may run faster inside the burst.
function State.interval(state: State, config: Config): number
	local rpm = config.Fire.RPM
	if state.mode == "Burst" and config.Fire.BurstRPM > 0 then
		rpm = config.Fire.BurstRPM
	end
	return 60 / rpm
end

-- Fires one round. Call canFire first.
function State.fire(state: State, config: Config, now: number)
	if state.action == "Reload" then
		state.action = "Idle"
	end

	if config.Realism.Chambering then
		state.chambered = false
		if not isManual(config) then
			chamberFromMagazine(state, config)
		end
	else
		state.mag -= 1
	end
	state.shots += 1

	-- Keep an exact cadence when the trigger is held: schedule from the last
	-- slot rather than from "now" when we are only a frame late.
	local interval = State.interval(state, config)
	local late = now - state.nextFire
	state.nextFire = (if late >= 0 and late < interval then state.nextFire else now) + interval

	if isManual(config) and state.mag > 0 then
		if config.Realism.ManualCycle then
			state.needsCycle = true
		else
			state.action = "Cycle"
			state.actionStart = now
			state.actionEnd = now + config.Fire.CycleTime
		end
	end
end

-- Starts a reload. Returns false when there is nothing to do.
function State.startReload(state: State, config: Config, now: number): boolean
	if state.action ~= "Idle" then
		return false
	end
	local missing = config.Ammo.Magazine - state.mag
	local hasReserve = config.Ammo.Infinite or state.reserve > 0
	if missing <= 0 or not hasReserve then
		return false
	end

	local duration: number
	if config.Ammo.ReloadType == "Single" then
		local available = if config.Ammo.Infinite then missing else math.min(missing, state.reserve)
		state.shellsToLoad = available
		state.shellsLoaded = 0
		duration = available * config.Ammo.ShellTime
	else
		local empty = not State.hasRound(state, config)
		duration = if empty and config.Ammo.ReloadEmptyTime > 0
			then config.Ammo.ReloadEmptyTime
			else config.Ammo.ReloadTime
	end

	state.action = "Reload"
	state.actionStart = now
	state.actionEnd = now + duration
	return true
end

-- Works the action by hand: clears a jam, or chambers the next round on a
-- bolt or pump weapon with Realism.ManualCycle.
function State.cycle(state: State, config: Config, now: number): boolean
	if state.action ~= "Idle" then
		return false
	end
	if not state.jammed and not state.needsCycle then
		return false
	end
	state.action = "Cycle"
	state.actionStart = now
	state.actionEnd = now + config.Fire.CycleTime
	return true
end

-- Switches to the next selectable fire mode. Returns false if there is only one.
function State.nextMode(state: State, config: Config): boolean
	local modes = config.Fire.Modes
	if #modes <= 1 then
		return false
	end
	local index = table.find(modes, state.mode) or 0
	state.mode = modes[index % #modes + 1]
	return true
end

-- 0 to 1 through the current action, for progress bars and animation.
function State.progress(state: State, now: number): number
	if state.action == "Idle" then
		return 1
	end
	local length = state.actionEnd - state.actionStart
	if length <= 0 then
		return 1
	end
	return math.clamp((now - state.actionStart) / length, 0, 1)
end

function State.snapshot(state: State, now: number): Snapshot
	return {
		state.mag,
		state.reserve,
		state.chambered,
		state.mode,
		state.action,
		now - state.actionStart,
		state.actionEnd - state.actionStart,
		state.shellsToLoad,
		state.shellsLoaded,
		state.needsCycle,
		state.jammed,
	}
end

-- Overwrites the predicted state with the server's. `now` is the local clock.
function State.apply(state: State, snapshot: Snapshot, now: number)
	state.mag = snapshot[1]
	state.reserve = snapshot[2]
	state.chambered = snapshot[3]
	state.mode = snapshot[4]
	state.action = snapshot[5]
	state.actionStart = now - snapshot[6]
	state.actionEnd = state.actionStart + snapshot[7]
	state.shellsToLoad = snapshot[8]
	state.shellsLoaded = snapshot[9]
	state.needsCycle = snapshot[10]
	state.jammed = snapshot[11]
end

return State
